到达可运行实现

这份调研回答一个具体问题:到目前为止,人们究竟用什么代价、在什么层次上、把哪些共识协议证明对了?

分布式共识的验证文献横跨三个几乎不互相引用的社区——系统(SOSP/OSDI/NSDI/EuroSys/ATC)、编程语言(PLDI/POPL/OOPSLA/ESOP)、形式化方法(CAV/FMCAD/ITP/CPP/FM/TACAS/DISC)——加上一批只有开源产物没有论文的工业实践。任何只看其中一个社区的综述都会得出严重偏斜的结论:只看系统会议会以为这个领域从 IronFleet 才开始,只看形式化方法会议会以为 Paxos 早在 2001 年就"验证完了"。

本调研按证明自动化程度组织,因为这是决定一项工作能否被复用的首要因素;在每一条目里再标注验证层次,因为"验证了 Paxos"这句话在抽象协议层和可执行实现层之间的工作量差了一到两个数量级。

0. 怎么读这份调研

0.1 三分类的判定标准

三分类的判定标准是"归纳不变式(inductive invariant)由谁提供",这是把验证代价撕成三档的那条分界线。

类别谁写归纳不变式求解器角色典型工具典型代价
纯手写人无,或仅做 trivial 化简Coq/Rocq、Isabelle/HOL、PVS、NuPRL、Agda、Lean、ACL2、Nqthm证明:代码 ≈ 10:1 ~ 100:1,人年级
半自动人自动放掉验证条件(VC)Dafny、Verus、Ivy(手写不变式)、TLAPS、Event-B、CIVL、Move Prover证明:代码 ≈ 4:1 ~ 12:1,人月级
纯自动机器推断不变式 / 穷举状态空间I4、DistAI、DuoAI、SWISS、IC3PO、mypyvy、TLC、Apalache、SPIN、ByMC分钟到小时的机器时间,人只写协议和性质

几个必须讲清楚的边界情况:

  1. Ivy 出现在两类里。 Ivy 本身是"人写不变式、Z3 在 EPR 可判定片段内放 VC"的半自动工具;但 I4、DistAI、DuoAI、SWISS、IC3PO 这些工作是用 Ivy 做后端、自动推断不变式,所以归入纯自动。判断依据是"人有没有写出那个归纳不变式",不是"用了哪个工具"。
  2. 模型检验算"纯自动",但要标注它的代价。 TLC / SPIN / Apalache 在有界的、有限实例上是全自动的,但结论也只对那些实例成立。它们不是定理证明的替代品,而是在写证明之前排除掉绝大多数错误的手段——工业界(AWS、MongoDB、Azure)的实际用法正是如此。参数化验证(阈值自动机、cutoff 定理)是这一类里唯一能给出"对任意节点数都成立"结论的分支。
  3. 交互式证明助手 + SMT hammer 仍算纯手写。 Isabelle 的 Sledgehammer、Coq 的 lia 只是把琐碎子目标自动化,证明的骨架和所有关键引理仍由人构造。反过来,Veil(Lean + SMT)把整个 VC 交给求解器,归入半自动。
  4. 笔算证明(pen-and-paper)少量收录。 Ongaro 的 Raft 博士论文、Zyzzyva 的反例、"Paxos Consensus, Deconstructed and Abstracted" 这类工作没有机械化,但在文献脉络里绕不开,统一放在第一类的最后一节并明确标注"非机械化"。

### 第二个维度:保证强度(务必与自动化程度分开看)

三分类回答的是"人付出了多少",它不回答"结论有多强"。这是两个正交的维度,混起来看会得出完全错误的结论。每一条目和每一张索引因此都同时带两个标签:

保证强度含义典型手段
无界证明结论对任意节点数、任意执行成立交互式定理证明、SMT 演绎验证、归纳不变式推断、参数化验证/cutoff
有界检验结论只对所检查的有限实例成立(如 3 节点 / 3 提案 / ballot ≤ 2)TLC、SPIN、Apalache、Alloy、UPPAAL、Maude、有界模型检验
仅找 bug不给出任何正确性保证,只做证伪、测试、或仅是规约/工具/基准产物dmck(SAMC/FlyMC/DEMi)、模糊测试、确定性仿真、Jepsen、轨迹校验、公开规约

为什么必须强调这一点。 "纯自动"这一档里,有界检验和测试类工作的数量远超无界证明类。以 Raft 为例:本调研的 Raft 协议族共 61 条,其中标为"纯自动"的有 40 条——但这 40 条里只有 4 条是无界证明,其余全是有界模型检验(TLA+/TLC、SPIN、mCRL2、LNT、PGo、SandTable)、测试工具(Jepsen、Antithesis、madsim、FlyMC、DEMi、Mallory)和工业界公开规约。

而那 4 条,没有一条证的是完整的 Raft:endive(FMCAD 2022)与 IC3Syn(2026 预印本)做的是 MongoDB 的 MLDR——一个 Raft 衍生的无日志重配置协议;Scythe(FMCAD 2024)综合的是一个 Raft 式重配置协议;Basilisk(OSDI 2025)只做了 Raft Leader Election,不含日志复制。

结论:带日志的完整 Raft,至今没有被任何全自动方法证明过。 Raft 真正的证明来自纯手写(Verdi Raft:530 行代码 / 50,000 行 Coq 证明)和半自动(Sift:Ivy + 精化,1 人月;Padon 等 PLDI 2018 的 Ivy 证明,论文明确说明不含日志截断、批处理、状态传输与崩溃恢复)。

0.2 验证层次:比工具更重要的那个维度

比"用了什么工具"更重要的是证明覆盖到了哪一层。同样一句"我们验证了 Paxos",在下面五档之间的工作量相差一到两个数量级:

层次含义代表工作
L1 抽象协议 · 安全性状态转移系统上的 agreement/consistency,节点数不限Paxos made EPR、I4、DistAI、DuoAI、SWISS、IC3PO
L2 抽象协议 · 活性加上公平性假设下的终止性/进展性Reducing Liveness to Safety、Temporal Prophecy、LVR、LiDO
L3 精化链抽象规约 → 中间层 → 可执行代码,层间证明精化IronFleet、Sift、AutoMan、Adore/AdoB、Igloo
L4 可执行实现抽出/编译出真正能跑的进程,含序列化、超时、持久化Verdi Raft(vard)、Velisarios(PBFT)、Grove(Go)、EventML/ShadowDB
L5 端到端系统上述全部 + 崩溃恢复 + 重配置 + 性能可用IronFleet(IronRSL)、Grove、Anvil、AutoMan(ByzRSL)

这份调研最重要的一个发现:进入 L4/L5 的工作在全部 415 条里只有 28 项(见 §5.4);而绝大多数被广泛引用的"自动验证 Paxos"结果都停在 L1。两者不是同一件事,不应该并列比较。

0.3 方法与可信度

  • 检索方式:多路并行检索(按工具族、按会议、按协议族、按年代切片),每一路独立搜索 DBLP / ACM DL / USENIX / arXiv / 作者主页,然后把结果合并去重。
  • 核验方式:每一条记录都由独立的第二轮 agent 重新核对标题、会议、年份、作者、实际验证的协议与层次,并尽可能从论文 PDF 里抠出证明代价的原始数字。会议归属错误(例如把 Verdi 记成 SOSP 而不是 PLDI 2015)是这类综述最常见的错误,因此逐条核对。
  • 核验结果:232 条一次通过,181 条被修正(多为会议/年份/页码/代价数字),2 条因超出范围被剔除(见附录 A),2 条无法在线独立核实(已标注 ⚠︎⚠︎)。
  • 可信度标注:每条带 high / medium / low。medium 通常意味着是预印本、尚未正式出版、或只有开源产物而无论文;low 意味着无法独立核实,引用前请自行确认。
  • 收录标准:核心是"对分布式共识/一致同意/原子广播/状态机复制协议做形式化推理"的工作。少量方法论上直接相关但目标不是共识的工作(如 QUIC 的 Ivy 规约、Serval、CertiKOS 谱系)也收录,并在备注里明确标为"邻域"。

2. 第一类:纯手写证明 119 项

Purely manual — interactive theorem proving

判定标准:人写出全部证明步骤;求解器不参与,或仅化简琐碎子目标。

2.1 早期基础:Byzantine 一致性与时钟同步的机械化证明(1982–2010)

Nqthm / HDM / EHDM / PVS era — 16 项

这是整个领域的起点,也是最容易被现代综述漏掉的一段。1980–2000 年代 NASA 资助下的 SRI(Rushby、Shankar、Lincoln、von Henke)和 CLI(Bevier、Young)用 HDM/EHDM/Nqthm/PVS 机械化了 Byzantine 一致性(interactive consistency)、容错时钟同步和 TTA/TTP 组成员协议。

两点值得今天的研究者注意。第一,SIFT(1982)是一个失败案例的教科书样本:1983 年的评审组认定其"已验证"的说法远超实际——证明没有触及 Pascal 代码,顶层规约更像是对实现的复述而不是独立需求。这直接催生了后来 SRI 更严谨的 EHDM/PVS 工作,也是"验证了什么层"这个问题在文献里第一次被严肃追问。第二,这一时期解决的是"共识的下层原语"(interactive consistency、时钟同步)而非 Paxos 式的复制状态机,所以它对现代共识验证的直接影响其实有限,更多是方法论遗产。

1Formal Specification and Mechanical Verification of SIFT: A Fault-Tolerant Flight Control System
IEEE Transactions on Computers, vol. C-31, no. 7, pp. 616-630, July 1982; DOI 10.1109/TC.1982.1676059
作者
P. M. Melliar-Smith and Richard L. Schwartz (SRI International, Computer Science Laboratory)
协议
SIFT interactive-consistency / Byzantine agreement and fault-masking majority voting for a replicated flight-control computer (Pease-Shostak-Lamport style broadcast plus majority vote)
验证层次
Hierarchy of design specifications: top-level reliability/fault-masking model, through an intermediate replication layer, down to the SIFT executive in a Pascal-like language. The mapping to the actual Pascal program was specified but only partially discharged.
工具
SRI Hierarchical Development Methodology (HDM) with the Shostak/Boyer-Moore-based STP theorem prover; multisorted first-order predicate calculus
自动化判定
纯手写 Humans wrote the full specification hierarchy and drove the prover through each refinement obligation; the prover only discharged individual first-order verification conditions handed to it.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Safety: a SIFT system in a 'safe' state continues to compute correctly despite arbitrary (Byzantine) faults in a bounded number of processors; fault masking and transient recovery.
证明代价
Not reported as a ratio or LOC; a multi-year NASA-funded effort spanning roughly 1977-1983
备注
This is the paper's main historiographic value and it directly motivated the more careful EHDM/PVS work at SRI (records 6 and 9 here). Related and independently confirmed: John Rushby, 'Formal specification and verification of a fault-masking and transient-recovery model for digital flight-control systems', FTRTFT 1992, LNCS pp. 237-257, DOI 10.1007/3-540-55092-5_13.
2Machine-Checked Proofs of the Design and Implementation of a Fault-Tolerant Circuit
NASA Contractor Report 182099 / NAS 1.26:182099, November 1990 (NASA contract NAS 1-18878). Journal version: 'Machine checked proofs of the design of a fault-tolerant circuit', Formal Aspects of Computing 4(Suppl. 1):755-775, 1992. Also: 'The Proof of Correctness of a Fault-Tolerant Circuit Design', Dependable Computing and Fault-Tolerant Systems (DCCA-2), pp. 243-260, 1992.
作者
William R. Bevier, William D. Young (Computational Logic, Inc., Austin TX)
协议
Pease-Shostak-Lamport Oral Messages algorithm for interactive consistency / Byzantine agreement, executed on a system of four processors
验证层次
Two layers plus the refinement between them: an abstract implementation of OM proved to achieve interactive consistency, and a hardware-level (circuit) description proved to implement the abstract design, inheriting its fault-tolerance properties
工具
Nqthm (the Boyer-Moore theorem prover)
自动化判定
纯手写 Definitions are given in the quantifier-free Boyer-Moore logic and proofs are driven by hand-supplied lemma sequences and induction hints, in the classic Nqthm style. The report notes that the invariant for IC2 'was the primary effort' and that IC1/IC2 are 'a fairly difficult exercise in mechanical theorem proving' with no proof discovery — Lamport, Shostak and Pease had supplied journal-level pro …
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Interactive consistency (IC1/IC2) of OM; the Pease-Shostak-Lamport optimality/impossibility result that no message-passing-only algorithm achieves interactive consistency with more faults (formalized using recently-added second-order-ish constructs of the Boyer-Moore logic); …
证明代价
Not reported in LOC or person-months. Rushby's CSL-92-01 uses this work as the comparison baseline for his own four-day EHDM OM verification.
备注
Note it is contemporaneous with, not later than, the EHDM ICA work (CSL-89-3R, 1989).
3Formal Verification of an Oral Messages Algorithm for Interactive Consistency
SRI CSL Technical Report CSL-92-01, July 1992; also NASA Contractor Report 189704 / NAS 1.26:189704, October 1992 (contract NAS1-18969). Not a refereed conference or journal paper.
作者
John Rushby (SRI International)
协议
Lamport-Shostak-Pease Oral Messages (OM) algorithm for Byzantine agreement / interactive consistency. Two formulations are treated: OMIC (interactive-consistency form) and OMBG (Byzantine Generals form).
验证层次
Abstract algorithm (recursive OM(m)); fault model formalized. No code.
工具
EHDM — the report's table of contents and body read 'Verification in EHDM'. PVS appears only as a secondary experiment: the OMBG formulation was used as a test case during PVS development, where 'we are now able to construct the main proofs for correctness of …
自动化判定
纯手写 Algorithm, fault model and the interactive-consistency conditions are specified in EHDM's higher-order language and discharged with hand-directed lemmas, case splits and inductions; EHDM proof-chain analysis checks completeness. The later PVS re-run is likewise user-directed.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Interactive consistency (validity + agreement among non-faulty processors) for OM(m) under the classical Byzantine fault model
证明代价
REPORTED, and worth quoting in the survey: 'Development of the formal specification and its verification in EHDM took about four days' with 23 subsidiary lemmas — versus 'about 40' days and 'nearly 200' lemmas for the same team's Interactive Convergence verification, and versus Bevier & Young's Boyer-Moore effort on OM. Main OMBG proofs reconstructed in PVS in under an hour.
备注
This report is the cleanest published proof:effort data point in the pre-1995 slice — Rushby explicitly frames it as a benchmark and invites others to redo it in their own systems.
4Machine Checked Proofs of the Design of a Fault-Tolerant Circuit ⚠︎
Formal Aspects of Computing, vol. 4, Suppl. 1, pp. 755-775, 1992; DOI 10.1007/BF03180571 (companion: 'The Proof of Correctness of a Fault-Tolerant Circuit Design', Dependable Computing for Critical Applications 2 / DCCA-2, Springer 1992, pp. 243-260, DOI 10.1007/978-3-7091-9198-9_12; earlier CLI Technical Report 57, 1990)
作者
William R. Bevier and William D. Young
协议
Pease-Shostak-Lamport Oral Messages (OM) Byzantine agreement / interactive consistency algorithm
验证层次
Abstract recursive OM algorithm refined down to a circuit-level (hardware) implementation, established as a refinement/simulation result.
工具
Nqthm (Boyer-Moore theorem prover)
自动化判定
纯手写 All lemmas, recursion schemes and induction hints were written by the authors; Nqthm's heuristics automate rewriting within a human-designed lemma hierarchy, but the refinement structure and every key invariant are hand-supplied.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety: interactive consistency (agreement plus validity) of the abstract OM algorithm, and preservation of that property by the concrete circuit-level implementation.
证明代价
Not reported as a ratio; the CLI reports describe a multi-month effort
备注
ACTION FOR THE SURVEY: open the FAC paper or CLI TR-57 before making any end-to-end claim for this entry — the difference between 'refined to a circuit design' and 'refined to running microprocessors' is exactly the kind of claim this survey should not get wrong.
5Mechanical Verification of a Generalized Protocol for Byzantine Fault Tolerant Clock Synchronization
FTRTFT 1992 (Formal Techniques in Real-Time and Fault-Tolerant Systems, 2nd Intl. Symposium), Springer LNCS 571, pp. 217-236. Underlying report: SRI-7398 / NASA CR-4386, 'Mechanical verification of a schematic Byzantine clock synchronization algorithm', July 1991.
作者
Natarajan Shankar (SRI International)
协议
Schneider's schematic/generalized Byzantine fault-tolerant clock synchronization protocol, plus the 'egocentric mean' convergence function of Lamport & Melliar-Smith's Interactive Convergence Algorithm as an instance

Abstract algorithm schema, with instantiation lemmas for concrete convergence functions
工具
EHDM (SRI; precursor to PVS) — confirmed verbatim in the NASA CR-4386 abstract
自动化判定
纯手写 Schneider's informal generalized proof is redone as a fully interactive EHDM development; the human supplies every definition, assumption and lemma.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Bounded skew / agreement and accuracy for any instance satisfying Schneider's conditions; verification that the egocentric mean function of ICA satisfies those conditions
证明代价
Not reported
备注
Damian Barsotti, 'Instances of Schneider's generalized protocol of clock synchronization', AFP, submitted 15 March 2006 (ICA and fault-tolerant midpoint; also experiments with ICS and CVC-lite); Barsotti, Prensa Nieto & Tiu, 'Verification of clock synchronization algorithms: experiments on a combination of deductive tools', Formal Aspects of Computing 19(3):321-341, 2007; Paul Miner, NASA TP-3349, November 1993 (with the Welch-Lynch generalization appearing in NASA TM-107634, June 1992).

402-411, CAV'93 LNCS pp. 292-304, and the FTCS-25 Highlights reprint). IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering, vol. 19, no. 1, pp. 13-23, January 1993 (earlier: SRI CSL Technical Report CSL-89-3R, February 1989, revised August 1991, also NASA Contractor Report 4239; conference version at ACM SIGSOFT Conf. on Software for Critical Systems, 1991)

2.2 Coq / Rocq 生态

Coq / Rocq — 37 项

Coq/Rocq 是"纯手写"这一档里产出最多、也最接近可运行代码的生态。三条主线:

  1. Verdi 谱系(华盛顿大学):Verdi(PLDI 2015)提出 verified system transformer,把"在理想网络上证明的协议"自动搬到有丢包/重复的网络语义下;Verdi Raft(CPP 2016)是这条线的顶点,也是整个领域最常被引用的代价数字——530 行 Raft 实现对 50,000 行 Coq 证明,90 条系统不变式,只证安全性不证活性。
  2. 分离逻辑/Iris 谱系:Disel(POPL 2018)、Aneris(ESOP 2020)、Perennial、Trillium(POPL 2024),到 Grove(SOSP 2023)——后者是目前唯一一个用分离逻辑验证到真实 Go 代码、且覆盖崩溃恢复与重配置的复制系统(2,435 行 Go 对 28,077 行 Coq,≈12:1)。
  3. BFT 与区块链:Velisarios(ESOP 2018)是第一个 Coq 验证并抽取出可运行 PBFT 的工作(约 1 人年,PBFT 部分 20,000 行规约 + 22,000 行证明,只证 agreement);其后 Asphalion、AdoB、LiDO、LiDO-DAG 把 Byzantine 与良性共识统一到 atomic distributed object 框架下,并首次给出 DAG 类共识的机械化活性证明。

17Verdi: A Framework for Implementing and Formally Verifying Distributed Systems
PLDI 2015, pp. 357-368 (June 2015, Portland, OR). Artifact Evaluated badge on the paper.
作者
James R. Wilcox, Doug Woos, Pavel Panchekha, Zachary Tatlock, Xi Wang, Michael D. Ernst, Thomas E. Anderson (University of Washington)
协议
Systems evaluated in Table 2: sequence numbering, a key-value store, primary-backup replication, the KV+PB composition, and Raft (linearizability). Raft is implemented as a verified system transformer.
验证层次
Executable implementation: Coq shallow-embedded event handlers extracted to OCaml and linked to a trusted shim; plus network semantics (fault models) and refinement between them via verified system transformers (VSTs)
工具
Coq (+ OCaml extraction, trusted shim)
自动化判定
纯手写 Confirmed. Every invariant and proof step is written by hand in Coq/Ltac; no SMT backend and no invariant inference.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety only — the paper states explicitly that it 'leave[s] proofs of liveness' to future work and that none of Verdi's network semantics currently support liveness. Raft linearizability, mutual exclusion, KV correctness, and the VST theorems transporting properties from an idealized fault model to a harsher one. …
证明代价
Key-value store 41/138/337; Primary-backup 20/134/1155; KV+PB 5/N-A/19; Raft (Linearizability) 170/520/4144; Verdi 148/220/2364.
备注
Canonical 'purely manual ITP proof that reaches executable code' data point. Verified system transformers are the reusability mechanism: an application verified under an idealized semantics inherits guarantees under a lossy/duplicating/reordering network. TCB = OCaml shim, Coq extraction, the OCaml runtime, and the fidelity of the network semantics. Note for the survey's common-error list: Verdi is PLDI 2015, not SOSP — confirmed.

Two causally-consistent replicated key-value store algorithms from the literature (dependency-tracking / vector-clock replication, COPS/Eiger-style). Not leader-based consensus.

纯手写 The two store implementations are proved by hand in Coq using a simulation/abstraction-relation technique; no SMT and no invariant inference. BUT the paper additionally 'implemented a simple automatic model checker' used to discharge the client-side correctness condition, so the work is not purely ITP — it is manual for the servers and automated (finite-state model checking) for clients.

无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立

No explicit LOC or person-month figure reported in the paper. Coq + extracted OCaml released publicly.
备注
Survey-relevant contribution is the modularity axis: separate correctness conditions for implementation and client, glued by an operational semantics of the consistency model — a template later echoed by Aneris/Chapar-style modular specs. Correctly positioned as weak-consistency adjacent rather than consensus.

无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立

The canonical cost-of-purely-manual-proof data point, and the largest proof:code ratio in this slice at ~94:1. Artifact: uwplse/verdi-raft, with vard as the running KV store. Directly motivated the Ivy/EPR and invariant-inference automation lines. 备注
ADD TO THE SURVEY: Disel proves only PARTIAL correctness — the fixpoint combinator admits non-terminating executions, so a verified Disel program may loop forever without ever violating the protocol. That is a materially weaker guarantee than 'safety' unqualified and it matters for any liveness column. | The paper also declines to state a formal adequacy theorem for extraction: the OCaml shim uses OS/network components with no formal semantics, so adequacy is argued informally (two reasons given). …

Correctly flagged as ADJACENT (storage, not consensus). 2.3 Isabelle/HOL 生态

Isabelle/HOL — 21 项

Isabelle/HOL 这一支的特点是抽象层次高、可复用性强,但基本不碰可执行代码。核心是 Charron-Bost 与 Merz 的 Heard-Of 模型:把轮次型容错算法统一成一个通信谓词框架,一次性证明多个共识算法(Fast Paxos、One-Third-Rule、UniformVoting、EIGByz)。Archive of Formal Proofs 里的 Heard_Of、DiskPaxos、GenClock、Chandy_Lamport、Stellar_Quorum_Systems 都是可直接复用的机械化资产。

区块链时代这条线被重新激活:Hirai 的 Casper FFG accountable safety 证明、Losa 与 Mazières 的 Stellar 共识形式化(并因此发现原协议的一个真实问题)、以及以太坊 epoch processing 的 rely-guarantee 优化验证。

2.4 I/O 自动机学派与 NuPRL/EventML

I/O automata & NuPRL — 19 项

两个历史上极重要、今天却几乎被遗忘的传统。

I/O 自动机(Lynch 学派,MIT):De Prisco、Lampson 与 Lynch 的 "Revisiting the Paxos Algorithm"(WDAG 1997 / TCS 2000)是 Paxos 的第一个真正严格的模块化正确性论证,用 I/O 自动机与 simulation relation 组织,并顺带给出了性能/延迟分析。这套方法论后来被 TLA+ 的精化框架吸收。这一支还发展出一整条工具链,今天基本无人使用但值得知道:Lynch–Vaandrager 的前向/后向仿真理论(1995–1996)、Isabelle/HOL 里的 I/O 自动机嵌入(1995)、PVS 上的 TAME 策略库(2000)、TIOA 与 Tempo 工具集(2006),以及能把 IOA 规约编译成可运行 Java 的 IOA 编译器——后者做出了 Time-Based Paxos 的自动实现(OPODIS 2010),是"从规约生成代码"这条路线在共识上的少数落地之一。

需要明确指出的一个空白:这一支最著名的产物 RAMBO(可重配置原子存储,DISC 2002 / Distributed Computing 2010)及其后继 RAMBO II、DynaStore(PODC 2009 / JACM 2011)、SmartMerge(DISC 2015)全部只有笔算的 I/O 自动机证明,从未在 IOA/PVS/TIOA 工具里机械化。唯一的例外是 RAMBO 的 Paxos 重配置子服务在 Larch Prover 里的证明(2002)。三十年过去,这个奠基性的可重配置共识/原子存储子领域仍然没有机器检查过的证明。

NuPRL / EventML(Cornell):Ensemble(SOSP 1999)把通信协议栈的组件在 NuPRL 里验证并做保正确性的优化;这条线在 2009–2017 年长成 EventML——从 Logic of Events 规约综合出可运行的崩溃容错复制服务(ShadowDB, DSN 2014),是"从证明里生成代码"而不是"给代码写证明"的少数几个真实例子。

79Revisiting the Paxos Algorithm
Theoretical Computer Science 243(1-2):35-91, July 2000, DOI 10.1016/S0304-3975(00)00042-6 (conference version: WDAG 1997, 11th Int. Workshop on Distributed Algorithms, LNCS 1320, pp. 111-125, DOI 10.1007/BFb0030679)
作者
Roberto De Prisco, Butler Lampson, Nancy A. Lynch
协议
Paxos (single-decree synod) and MultiPaxos (multi-decree parliament), plus leader-election and failure-detection components

Abstract protocol layer, formally decomposed into interacting automata components; covers safety, conditional liveness, and quantitative time-performance
工具
I/O automata — specifically a Clock General Timed Automaton (Clock GTA) model built on Lynch-Vaandrager GTA. Proofs are rigorous hand proofs (invariants plus forward simulations), NOT machine-checked.

纯手写 Every invariant, simulation relation and timing bound is written and proved by hand in the I/O automata framework; no theorem prover or solver is involved at all.

无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立

Not reported as a ratio; the TCS version runs to 57 journal pages
备注
Because the automation field is 'manual' with no prover at all, make sure the survey's tables do not let this entry be read as a mechanized result. | The foundational I/O-automata treatment of Paxos. Decomposition into a "main algorithm" plus three timing-dependent components that determine when to start a new ballot; performance analysis is the distinguishing feature versus later machine-checked Paxos proofs, which cover safety only. Note for the survey: this is the *hand* proof; record #5 is the machine-checked successor by an overlapping author set.

无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立

备注
Confidence lowered from high to medium ONLY on the negative claim, not the citation. The citation is fully confirmed. Nothing I found contradicts it, and the related-work strand (RAMBO II, DSN 2003; Long-Lived RAMBO; the Gramoli/Nicolaou/Schwarzmann 2021 Synthesis Lecture 'Consistent Distributed Storage', ch. 7 'RAMBO: Reconfigurable Dynamic Memory') is likewise hand-proved. For the survey, state the negative as 'we are not aware of a mechanised RAMBO proof' rather than as an established absence.

2.5 Agda / Lean / ACL2 及非机械化的严格论证

Agda, Lean, ACL2, and rigorous pen-and-paper proofs — 26 项

收尾的杂项,但有两类值得单独看。

其他证明助手:Agda(HotStuff/LibraBFT 的 append-only skip list 与 BFT 组件)、Lean 4(Zug 原子广播)、ACL2(DAG-BFT nonforking)、Athena(Synod 的 eventual consensus)。Agda 这一支来自 Diem/Novi 团队,是少数把工业 BFT 实现直接翻译进依赖类型语言的尝试。

非机械化但绕不开的严格论证:Ongaro 的 Raft 博士论文(2014,TLA+ 规约 + 笔算证明)、"Paxos Consensus, Deconstructed and Abstracted"(ESOP 2018)、以及 Abraham 等人对 Zyzzyva 安全性缺陷的发现(2017)——后者是"发表并被广泛引用的 BFT 协议在多年后被人工分析推翻"的标志性案例,直接说明了为什么这个领域需要机械化证明。

The raft.tla repository (github.com/ongardie/raft.tla, CC-BY-4.0) is slightly updated relative to the dissertation version. Refutation: Zyzzyva's safety (prefix consistency across view changes) does not hold; FaB Paxos's liveness does not hold. The Thelma/Velma/Zelma follow-up sketches fixes with unmechanized proofs.
证明代价
N/A
备注
Confirmed directly from https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.01367 (title, six authors, 4 Dec 2017 submission, abstract quote) and https://arxiv.org/abs/1801.10022 (follow-up, four authors, 26 Jan 2018). The survey point stands: a widely re-implemented SOSP protocol whose safety bug needs only 4 replicas and 2 view changes — well within any bounded model checker's reach — was found by hand a decade later.
104Revisiting Fast Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (arXiv:1712.01367) — and the separate follow-up, Revisiting Fast Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance: Thelma, Velma, and Zelma (arXiv:1801.10022)
arXiv:1712.01367 (4 Dec 2017) and arXiv:1801.10022 (26 Jan 2018, comment notes text overlap with 1712.01367). Neither is peer-reviewed; dblp shows no conference or journal version.

仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准

Nothing proven. 1712.01367 exhibits a safety violation in Zyzzyva and a liveness violation in FaB; 1801.10022 sketches fixes, applying a common view-change core to both and combining them into a single enhanced scheme (Thelma, Velma, Zelma).

N/A.
备注
Both abstracts verified directly. This is correctly identified as the canonical motivation in the literature: Zyzzyva (SOSP 2007 / TOCS 2009) was unsafe for roughly a decade. Note for the survey that neither note is peer-reviewed, which is slightly awkward given its rhetorical weight — pair it with the Twins and Tholoniat/Gramoli entries, which independently corroborate the bugs.

The arXiv abstract confirms the protocol's distinguishing mechanism verbatim — Caesar allows a fast decision to proceed 'even when a quorum of nodes reply with different dependency sets for that request'. That is precisely the dependency-set-agreement machinery EPaxos got wrong, which makes the absence of a mechanized proof for Caesar a legitimate survey-relevant observation. Confidence held at medium solely because of the tool field.
106Paxos Consensus, Deconstructed and Abstracted

协议
Single-decree Paxos (deconstructed following Boichat et al. into Round-Based Register / Round-Based Consensus / Weak Leader Election layers) and Multi-Paxos, plus protocol-aware optimizations (leader-driven phase-2-only operation, value-selection, and the ground for master leases and epoch numbering)
验证层次
Refinement between layers. Novel non-deterministic specifications are given for each module of the deconstruction, implementations are proved to refine them, and Multi-Paxos is then obtained from verified single-decree Paxos by a family of protocol-aware, behaviour-preserving transformations of the network semantics - so proofs of unchanged modules are reused across implementations.

纯手写 Every proof step is written by a human - but note the proofs are pen-and-paper, NOT mechanized in an interactive theorem prover, so this sits at the manual end of the taxonomy without the machine-checking guarantee that Coq/Isabelle entries carry. This should be flagged explicitly if the survey's "manual" bucket is defined as ITP-based.

无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立

Linearizability of each module implementation with respect to its non-deterministic specification, and behaviour-preservation of the network-semantics transformations that lift single-decree Paxos to Multi-Paxos.
证明代价
not reported as LOC/person-months; the extended version's appendices contain the full linearization proofs
备注
The first treatment giving a Multi-Paxos verification that directly reuses the single-decree Paxos proof. Direct precursor of the Disel/DPC line (Sergey is a co-author of both). Caveat on the survey brief: the paper covers SD-Paxos, its deconstruction, protocol-aware optimizations, and Multi-Paxos - it does NOT verify Fast Paxos, multi-coordinated Paxos, or Byzantine variants (Fast Paxos is only cited as related TLA+ work by Lamport).

3. 第二类:半自动证明 86 项

Semi-automated — SMT-backed deductive verification

判定标准:人写规约、归纳不变式与引理结构;SMT/求解器自动放掉验证条件(VC)。

3.1 Dafny 与 IronFleet 谱系

Dafny / IronFleet lineage — 21 项

IronFleet(SOSP 2015)是整个领域的分水岭,第一次把"TLA 风格的精化"塞进 SMT 后端的程序验证器里,一次性给出了 Multi-Paxos 复制状态机(IronRSL)的安全性 + 活性 + 可执行实现。它的代价数字被后续所有工作当作基线:1,400 行可信规约、5,114 行实现、39,253 行证明(≈7.7:1),验证耗时 395 分钟。

之后这条线的全部努力都在降低那个 7.7:1:

  • Sift(ATC 2022) 用 refinement-guided automation 把 Raft 做到 1 人月(对比原 Ivy 证明的 3 人月)。
  • Kondo / Inductive Invariants That Spark Joy(OOPSLA 2024) 用不变式分类法把样板证明自动化。
  • AutoMan(SOSP 2025) 从协议级 Dafny 规约自动生成可执行实现与精化证明,做出了带吞吐量数字的 ByzRSL。
  • Armada、Linear Dafny、IronSync(OSDI 2023) 处理并发与线性资源。
  • Mariposa(2023)、IronSpec(OSDI 2024)、Proof Actions(2024) 则是这条线的"元问题":SMT 不稳定性、规约本身对不对、证明怎么调试。

120Ironclad Apps: End-to-End Security via Automated Full-System Verification
OSDI 2014, pp. 165-181
作者
Chris Hawblitzel, Jon Howell, Jacob R. Lorch, Arjun Narayan (Penn), Bryan Parno, Danfeng Zhang (Cornell), Brian Zill — Microsoft Research + academic co-authors
协议
Not a consensus protocol: four security apps (Notary, PassHash, TrInc, DiffPriv) on a verified kernel/driver/crypto stack. TrInc is a distributed trusted-counter primitive used by BFT protocols.
验证层次
End-to-end single-machine system: from a high-level functional/security spec down to verified assembly (BoogieX86), including kernel, drivers, SHA/HMAC/RSA, and the apps. No distributed-protocol layer.
工具
Dafny + Boogie + Z3; custom verified-assembly toolchain (BoogieX86), with DafnyCC compiling a Dafny subset to verifiable assembly; DafnySpec, SymDiff for relational (noninterference) properties
自动化判定
半自动 Humans wrote all specs, loop invariants, and lemma structure in Dafny; Z3 discharged the verification conditions, so the SMT solver did proof search but not invariant discovery. Paper explicitly contrasts this with interactive proof assistants (seL4).
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Functional correctness of the whole stack plus noninterference-style end-to-end security (remote-equivalence) for the apps; no liveness.
证明代价
Reported ratios: implementation:spec = 2:1; proof-annotation:implementation = 4.8:1 (paper compares this to seL4's ~20:1). Verification time 10,726 s (~3 h) for functional correctness plus 76,606 s (~21 h) for relational properties. 'We constructed the entire Ironclad system with under three person-years of effort.' TCB tools total 15,302 SLOC (DafnySpec 4,718 + BoogieX86 2,182 + ... ); DafnyCC (4,292 SLOC) is out of the TCB.
备注
The direct methodological precursor to IronFleet by the same MSR group. Its key legacy is the 'automated full-system verification' discipline — a small trusted spec, everything below it proven in Dafny/Z3 — plus the demonstration that Dafny could be pushed down to machine code. ADJACENT — not distributed consensus, but it established the Dafny/Z3 systems-verification pipeline that IronFleet extended to distributed protocols one year later at SOSP'15.
121IronFleet: Proving Practical Distributed Systems Correct
SOSP 2015, pp. 1-17 (DBLP conf/sosp/HawblitzelHKLPRSZ15)
作者
Chris Hawblitzel, Jon Howell, Manos Kapritsos, Jacob R. Lorch, Bryan Parno, Michael L. Roberts, Srinath Setty, Brian Zill — Microsoft Research
协议
IronRSL — a feature-complete Multi-Paxos replicated state machine (proposer/acceptor/learner/executor, view change, log truncation, batching, state transfer, reply caching); IronKV/IronSHT — a lease-based sharded key-value store with key delegation and reliable delivery.
验证层次
End-to-end system, three layers linked by refinement: (1) trusted top-level spec (85 SLOC for IronRSL, 34 for IronKV), (2) untrusted abstract distributed protocol layer (TLA-style state machine over an asynchronous network), (3) executable single-host implementation compiled to C#/.NET, plus a reduction argument connecting per-host atomic protocol steps to the real interleaved execution and a trus …
工具
Dafny (+ Boogie + Z3); a TLA embedding built inside Dafny — a verified library of 40 fundamental TLA proof rules (incl. Lamport's WF1, whose proof is 16 lines of Dafny) used for the liveness proofs
自动化判定
半自动 The developer hand-writes the spec, the protocol state machine, every inductive invariant, every refinement relation, and all lemma structure; Dafny/Z3 only discharge the resulting verification conditions. Section 6 of the paper documents fighting quantifier-instantiation heuristics, opaque/fuel attributes, and manual trigger tuning.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Safety (IronRSL linearizability — the distributed system refines a centralized state-machine spec) AND liveness (every client request is eventually answered, under a quorum of live replicas, a fair network, bounded clock error, bounded burst size). Does not assume reliable delivery, but does assume the network does not tamper with packets.
证明代价
Implementation-layer proof:code ratio stated in the paper as 3.6:1; overall proof:impl = 39,253/5,114 ≈ 7.7:1 (the '~7:1' figure IronSync/VeriBetrKV cite). 'Developing the IronFleet methodology and applying it to build and verify two real systems required approximately 3.7 person-years.' Full serial integration build ~6 hours; developer waits 6-8 minutes in practice with parallel cloud verification.
备注
Performance (verified in §7.2): IronRSL peak throughput within 2.4x of an unverified Go MultiPaxos baseline taken from the EPaxos codebase; IronKV 'competitive with' Redis. Both systems 'worked the first time we ran them.' The reduction argument is a paper-only proof at the time of publication (listed as future work to mechanize). TCB: two top-level specs, trusted UDP/network spec and main-event-loop harness, Dafny + Z3 + .NET compiler + OS. Every later work in this slice (Sift, Kondo, Basilisk, IronSpec, VeriBetrKV, IronSync, SWISS) positions itself against IronFleet's proof burden; SWISS cites the 3.7 person-ye …
122An Empirical Study on the Correctness of Formally Verified Distributed Systems
EuroSys 2017, pp. 328-343, DOI 10.1145/3064176.3064183
作者
Pedro Fonseca, Kaiyuan Zhang, Xi Wang, Arvind Krishnamurthy — University of Washington
协议
Studies the artifacts of IronFleet (Multi-Paxos, i.e. IronRSL; 34K lines of Dafny/C#), Verdi (Raft; 54K lines of Coq/OCaml), and Chapar (causally-consistent KV store; 20K lines of Coq/OCaml)
验证层次
Cross-layer: examines the trusted specifications, the verification tools themselves, and the unverified shim/runtime code — i.e., the TCB rather than the proofs
工具
Systematic testing / fault injection + code review against verified systems; the systems studied use Dafny (IronFleet) and Coq (Verdi, Chapar)
自动化判定
半自动 Not itself a proof effort — it is an empirical bug hunt using code review and systematic testing; classification is not really applicable. The subject systems span semi-auto (IronFleet, Dafny+Z3) and manual (Verdi, Chapar, Coq) verification.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
None proven; instead it falsifies the informal claim that verified systems are bug-free
证明代价
not reported (study, not a proof). The authors note they spent more than eight months searching for protocol bugs and found none.
备注
THE canonical critique of IronFleet's/Verdi's/Chapar's TCB. Critically important negative result for the survey: 'verified' at these venues does not mean bug-free, because the specs, shims and verifiers sit outside the proof. Direct motivation for IronSpec (OSDI'24) and for trace-validation approaches. IronFleet's own spec limitation is called out (§5): IronFleet's specification does not guarantee exactly-once semantics.

124Kaizen: Building a Performant Blockchain System Verified for Consensus and Integrity
FMCAD 2019 (Formal Methods in Computer-Aided Design), pp. 96-104. DOI 10.23919/FMCAD.2019.8894248
作者
Faria Kalim, Karl Palmskog, Jayasi Mehar, Adithya Murali, Indranil Gupta, P. Madhusudan (UIUC / UT Austin / Facebook)
协议
Nakamoto-style blockchain consensus based on the Pîrlea-Sergey Toychain blockchain-forest formalization, plus a cryptocurrency (KznCoin) built over it. Crash-fault, NOT Byzantine — the paper states nodes and network are not Byzantine and nodes may fail by crashing; extending to Byzantine conditions is listed as future work.
验证层次
End-to-end system in three stages: abstract protocol proved in Coq (reusing Pîrlea & Sergey's Toychain) -> translated to Dafny and refined to performant imperative Dafny code with Z3-discharged VCs -> compiled/linked to C# for the deployable system, evaluated on a 30-node Emulab cluster against the stock Bitcoin implementation.
工具
Coq (abstract protocol) + Dafny/Z3 (refinement to imperative code) + C# (deployment and network shim)
自动化判定
半自动 Confirmed as a genuine hybrid and correctly classified. The abstract consensus proof is manual Coq inherited from Toychain; the paper's own contribution — the refinement chain from protocol to performant imperative code — is Dafny deductive verification where the human writes contracts, invariants and ghost code and Z3 discharges the VCs. …
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety AND liveness, where liveness means eventual consistency. The paper states the implementation 'inherits all the safety and liveness (eventual consistency) properties proved for the abstract protocol in Coq' and that 'our approach ensures both safety and liveness properties of the blockchain and cryptocurrency system'. …
证明代价
Additions to the original Coq proof: 1,119 lines. Blockchain refinement in Dafny: 4,937. Bitcoin refinement in C#: 915. Network shim in C#: 4,159. Development effort: 4 developers over 4 months, all part-time, 50% verification experts and 50% distributed-systems experts. The 680-lines-of-Dafny custom map structure (replacing Dafny's built-in map for performance) is confirmed. Evaluation: 30-node Emulab cluster; …
备注
96-104, all six authors. Trusted base is enumerated in the paper: Coq proof checkers, Dafny and its provers, compilers, and the translation from the Coq protocol to Dafny contracts (Phase 3) — that last one is a hand-done, unverified step and is the weakest link in the end-to-end chain; a survey should say so. The paper's own comparison notes seL4 took 22 person-years for 8,700 lines of verified C, versus Kaizen's 4 part-time developers over 4 months — useful but reflects Kaizen's much narrower verification scope.
125Armada: Low-Effort Verification of High-Performance Concurrent Programs
PLDI 2020, pp. 197-210, DOI 10.1145/3385412.3385971 (Distinguished Paper Award)
作者
Jacob R. Lorch, Yixuan Chen, Manos Kapritsos, Bryan Parno, Shaz Qadeer, Upamanyu Sharma, James R. Wilcox, Xueyuan Zhao
协议
Not a consensus protocol: four shared-memory concurrency case studies — Barrier (the barrier of Schirmer & Cohen, chosen because it is incompatible with ownership-based proofs), Pointers (multi-pointer program), MCSLock (Mellor-Crummey/Scott lock), and Queue (lock-free queue from the liblfds library)
验证层次
Refinement between layers of a C-like concurrent program down to executable code with an arbitrary memory layout and custom synchronization; small-step state-machine semantics expressed in Dafny; C backend targets CompCertTSO so emitted code respects x86-TSO
工具
Armada language + tool built on Dafny (Z3); modifies Dafny's AST/parser and adds a 1,767-SLOC C backend compatible with CompCertTSO
自动化判定
半自动 The developer writes a stack of program levels and picks a proof strategy per level (the implementation ships eight strategies: rely-guarantee, TSO elimination, reduction, weakening, variable introduction/hiding, etc.); Armada then auto-generates the Dafny refinement proof and Dafny/Z3 checks it — but the layering, annotations and strategy choices are human-supplied.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Refinement (each level refines the one above), hence functional correctness and absence of undefined behavior; no liveness
证明代价
Tool sizes from §6 of the PDF: state-machine translator 13,191 new SLOC of C#; proof framework 3,322 SLOC of C#; general-purpose proof library 5,618 SLOC of Dafny; 873 SLOC of common Armada Dafny definitions included in each generated state machine; 1,767-SLOC Dafny C backend. The paper does not report person-months. IronSync (OSDI'23 §9) notes Armada's largest example takes 4.9 hours of CPU time (~40 min wall clock) …
备注
Included as an IronFleet-lineage methodology relative: overlapping MSR/Michigan/CMU authors, same refinement-in-Dafny philosophy, but applied to shared-memory rather than message-passing concurrency. Its sound-extensibility framework is the mechanism later reused to lower proof cost. Repo: github.com/microsoft/Armada.
126Storage Systems are Distributed Systems (So Verify Them That Way!)
OSDI 2020, pp. 99-115
作者
Travis Hance (CMU), Andrea Lattuada (ETH Zurich), Chris Hawblitzel (MSR), Jon Howell (VMware Research), Rob Johnson (VMware Research), Bryan Parno (CMU)
协议
Not a consensus protocol: VeriBetrKV, a crash-safe key-value store built on a B^eps-tree, verified by treating the disk as an asynchronous 'distributed' environment
验证层次
End-to-end: trusted 283-line crash-safe dictionary spec, multi-level state-machine refinement chain (Map/CrashSafeMap -> AbstractBetree -> Betree -> CompositeViewMap -> BetreeIOSystem -> ConcreteIOSystem), down to an executable implementation compiled to C++ via a new Dafny backend
工具
Dafny + Z3, with a lightweight linear type system integrated with dynamic frames and a custom Dafny C++ backend
自动化判定
半自动 Straight IronFleet-style deductive verification: humans write the refinement relations, invariants and lemmas; Dafny/Z3 discharge VCs. The contribution is proof-engineering discipline (keeping per-lemma verification times low), not invariant inference.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Functional correctness + crash safety (revert-to-last-sync semantics) + robustness to disk-sector corruption, under an asynchronous, reordering I/O bus. Liveness explicitly out of scope ('liveness ... is out of scope', §1).
证明代价
However, VeriBetrKV's implementation is 3x larger, indicating that automated verification techniques can scale to larger systems without super-linear effort.' Linear reasoning reduced proof overhead by 31-37% on two rewritten components (Table 2). 99.0% of definitions/methods/lemmas verify in under 20 s; 98.3% under 10 s. Implementation is >5x larger than its 283-line specification. No person-months reported.
备注
99-115. ADJACENT (storage) but materially informs consensus verification: the clearest demonstration that IronFleet's 'program + asynchronous environment' refinement recipe generalizes, and it introduces the scaling discipline (module boundaries, opaque functions, verification-time budgeting) later reused by IronSync and Verus-based work. Artifacts: secure-foundations/veribetrkv-osdi2020, vmware-labs/verified-betrfs.

作者
Jialin Li (U. Washington), Andrea Lattuada (ETH Zurich), Yi Zhou (CMU), Jonathan Cameron (CMU), Jon Howell (VMware Research), Bryan Parno (CMU), Chris Hawblitzel (MSR)
协议
Not a protocol paper: the type-system foundation (Linear Dafny) later used for IronSync's concurrent systems and for Verus
验证层次
Language/type-system layer supporting verified systems implementations (heap/aliasing reasoning)
工具
Linear Dafny — Dafny extended with linear (ownership) types, + Z3

130Sift: Using Refinement-guided Automation to Verify Complex Distributed Systems
USENIX ATC 2022, pp. 151-166
作者
Haojun Ma, Hammad Ahmad, Aman Goel, Eli Goldweber, Jean-Baptiste Jeannin, Manos Kapritsos, Baris Kasikci — University of Michigan
协议
Six systems: ring leader election, distributed/toy lock, two-phase commit, sharded hash table (SHT), Raft, and MultiPaxos. Raft and MultiPaxos are the headline results; the MultiPaxos model is derived from the prior EPR/Ivy MultiPaxos with some retransmissions removed to simplify refinement.
验证层次
Specification -> one or more intermediate layers -> executable implementation. Implementations are written in Ivy and extracted to C++ by Ivy's compiler, so the proof reaches running code — not just the abstract protocol.
工具
Ivy (protocol + implementation language, C++ extraction) with IC3PO as the monolithic invariant-inference back end; I4, SWISS and DistAI were tried and found weaker. NOT a Dafny tool despite being an IronFleet-lineage refinement methodology.
自动化判定
半自动 CORRECTED from 'auto'. For most refinement steps the human supplies only the layer descriptions and the safety/refinement property and IC3PO infers the inductive invariant — but the paper's own evaluation shows substantial human work: the spec->layer-0 refinement was proved MANUALLY for Raft (2 person-weeks, 'IC3PO was unable to handle' the quantifier alternations) …
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety only, via refinement of the implementation to the specification. No liveness — the paper notes no automation-oriented tool in this space supports liveness proofs.
证明代价
MultiPaxos ~3 person-weeks, with ~2 person-weeks producing the three additional intermediate layers and converting preconditions, and 'about one third of the time is spent waiting for IC3PO to run out of time or memory'; SHT <30 min after layering. IC3PO per-refinement times of roughly 100-1,300 s and memory of a few hundred MB up to 4,178 MB. Layer sizes are tiny: Raft implementation 212 lines of Ivy, Raft layer 0 143 lines, MultiPaxos layer 0 88 lines.
备注
First mostly-automated proofs of implementations of Raft and MultiPaxos. Sift's MultiPaxos (no batching) is comparable to IronRSL's reported non-batched numbers, and the authors report they could not reproduce IronRSL's published performance when re-running it. 131Performal: Formal Verification of Latency Properties for Distributed Systems
PLDI 2023 — Proc. ACM Program. Lang. 7, PLDI, Article 121 (June 2023), 26 pages, pp. 368-393. DOI 10.1145/3591235
作者
Tony Nuda Zhang (U. Michigan), Upamanyu Sharma (MIT CSAIL) — joint first authors — and Manos Kapritsos (U. Michigan)
协议
Three applications: (1) a distributed lock (ring of n nodes passing a token), (2) IronRSL, the MultiPaxos-based state-machine-replication system from IronFleet, (3) the start-up phase of ZooKeeper
验证层次
Mixed. For the distributed lock and IronRSL: real executables produced by Dafny's Go compiler, proven against symbolic end-to-end latency bounds. For ZooKeeper the deployed code is the real Java implementation, so the proof is over a model of its start-up phase rather than over compiled-from-Dafny code. …
工具
Dafny (+ Z3); Dafny's Go compiler for the executables; builds on IronFleet's TLA-in-Dafny infrastructure
自动化判定
半自动 Confirmed. The developer defines the symbolic-latency instrumentation, states the bound, and writes the inductive argument over execution steps; Dafny/Z3 discharge the VCs. No inference of latency invariants.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Worst-case end-to-end latency upper bounds (symbolic), including an IronRSL bound under node failure — a performance property, not safety. First mechanized end-to-end latency proofs of distributed implementations.
证明代价
No single proof:code ratio reported in the paper; effort is presented per case study rather than as an aggregate figure. Record's hedge was accurate.
备注
Author affiliations confirmed: Zhang and Kapritsos at Michigan, Sharma at MIT CSAIL; Zhang and Sharma are marked as equal contributors. Paper explicitly frames itself against IronFleet: IronFleet proved 'eventually', Performal proves 'within X'. Chapter 5 of Tony Nuda Zhang's 2025 Michigan dissertation.
132Sharding the State Machine: Automated Modular Reasoning for Complex Concurrent Systems
OSDI 2023 (17th USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation), pp. 911-929
作者
Travis Hance, Yi Zhou, Andrea Lattuada, Reto Achermann, Alex Conway, Ryan Stutsman, Gerd Zellweger, Chris Hawblitzel, Jon Howell, Bryan Parno
协议
NOT consensus. Two shared-memory concurrent systems: (1) NR, a library for black-box replication on NUMA architectures (node replication), and (2) a highly concurrent page cache. Verified with a sharded-state-machine / Localized Transition System methodology in Linear Dafny.
验证层次
Executable implementation of concurrent libraries with application-specific synchronization; data safety and functional correctness against a sequential spec. The paper explicitly does NOT verify liveness, termination, or deadlock-freedom.
工具
Linear Dafny (Dafny extended with Rust-inspired ownership/linear types); compiles via Dafny's C++ backend
自动化判定
半自动 Correct as submitted. The human supplies the sharded state machine, the Localized Transition System, invariants and transition proofs; the SMT solver discharges the verification conditions. The paper's own framing is 'substantially automated' per isolated concern, not push-button.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Data safety and logical/functional correctness of concurrent implementations against sequential specs. Explicitly out of scope: liveness, termination, deadlock-freedom.
证明代价
Paper's own comparison points: GoJournal reports 19:1 for its shared-memory code; Armada's largest example needs 4.9 hours CPU (~40 min wall) to verify 70 lines.
备注
Correctly flagged by the submitter as NOT a consensus result -- it verifies node-local shared-memory concurrency, not distributed agreement. Worth keeping as the shared-memory sibling of the IronFleet/Verus line, and the 7.5 proof:code ratio is a genuinely useful comparison anchor against the IronFleet-family numbers. Note also that the trusted computing base includes the IronSync framework's own Dafny encoding.
133Sharding the State Machine: Automated Modular Reasoning for Complex Concurrent Systems (IronSync)
OSDI 2023, pp. 911-929
作者
Travis Hance (CMU), Yi Zhou (CMU), Andrea Lattuada (ETH Zurich), Reto Achermann (UBC), Alex Conway (VMware Research), Ryan Stutsman (Utah), Gerd Zellweger (VMware Research), Chris Hawblitzel (MSR), Jon Howell (VMware Research), Bryan Parno (CMU)
协议
Not a consensus protocol: a Node Replication (NR) library providing black-box linearizable replication across NUMA nodes via a shared operation log and flat combining, and SplinterCache, a production-scale disk-backed in-memory page cache from SplinterDB
验证层次
Executable shared-memory concurrent implementations (compiled via Dafny's C++ backend) proven to refine a Localized Transition System (LTS) and thence a simple sequential spec; primary LTS plus secondary 'guard protocol' LTSes
工具
IronSync framework on Linear Dafny (ownership/linear types + ghost ownership, Atomic and Cell types) + Z3
自动化判定
半自动 The ownership type system plus LTS sharding makes each obligation locally SMT-dischargeable, but the developer still designs the transition system, the shard decomposition, and the invariants; the encoding of the IronSync framework in Dafny is itself trusted (stated in §1 of the paper).
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Data safety (no races/aliasing bugs) and logical correctness (linearizability against a sequential spec). Explicitly out of scope, verbatim: 'we do not verify liveness, termination, or deadlock-freedom.'
证明代价
From §7.1 of the paper: the four examples comprise 2,747 lines of non-ghost implementation plus 316 lines of shared library; within implementation files the proof-to-code ratio is about 4:1, and adding LTS code and refinement proofs raises the overall proof:code ratio to 7.5:1. 88% of files verify in under a minute, the slowest under five. Reference implementations: NR ~1,000 lines of Rust; SplinterCache ~2,000 lines of C. …
备注
Methodology relative rather than a consensus proof — but its Localized Transition System idea is the shared-memory analogue of IronFleet's per-host protocol refinement, and NR is literally a replication library. TCB: the spec, Dafny, and the IronSync framework encoding. ADJACENT (shared-memory concurrency, not distributed consensus) but methodologically load-bearing: it transplants the distributed-systems state-machine-refinement idiom into concurrent code and feeds the Verus design (SOSP'24).
134Inductive Invariants That Spark Joy: Using Invariant Taxonomies to Streamline Distributed Protocol Proofs
OSDI 2024, pp. 837-853 ('Analysis of Correctness' session)
作者
Tony Nuda Zhang, Travis Hance, Manos Kapritsos, Tej Chajed, Bryan Parno
协议
Exactly ten protocols, confirmed against the paper's evaluation table: Echo Server, Ring Leader Election, Simplified Leader Election, Two-Phase Commit, Paxos, Flexible Paxos, Distributed Lock, ShardedKV, ShardedKV-Batched, Lock Server
验证层次
Abstract protocol layer only — IronFleet-style state machines in Dafny; no executable implementation. Kondo lifts a proof of a synchronous model to the fully asynchronous, history-preserving model.
工具
Kondo, an extension/fork of the Dafny language and compiler (+ Z3)
自动化判定
半自动 Confirmed. The developer still manually devises the Protocol Invariants by proving a synchronous version; Kondo auto-generates the asynchronous protocol description, the Regular Invariants (monotonicity + ownership), their inductiveness proofs, and a draft proof the user often must patch.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety only — inductive invariant plus safety theorem checked by Dafny. Paper states explicitly that liveness proofs are beyond its scope, and that Kondo is not applicable in a Byzantine fault model.
证明代价
Distributed Lock, ShardedKV and ShardedKV-Batched require zero hand-written invariants; Paxos and Flexible Paxos drop from 27 to 20 clauses. Synchronous (Psync) protocol descriptions range 183-633 LoC (values: 260, 183, 255, 400, 631, 633, 194, 213, 225, 287).
备注
Taxonomy confirmed: Regular Invariants (mechanically derivable — monotonicity, ownership) vs. Protocol Invariants (high-level inter-host reasoning). Genuine boundary case between the semi-auto and auto buckets. Superseded by Basilisk (OSDI'25) from overlapping authors, which is built as a fork of the Kondo artifact. Chapter 3 of Tony Nuda Zhang's 2025 Michigan dissertation. | The Protocol/Regular invariant taxonomy is the conceptual contribution. Paxos reduction is the weakest (27->20) …
135IronSpec: Increasing the Reliability of Formal Specifications
OSDI 2024, pp. 875-891 ('Analysis of Correctness' session)
作者
Eli Goldweber, Weixin Yu, Seyed Armin Vakil Ghahani, Manos Kapritsos (all University of Michigan)
协议
14 specifications evaluated. Six are of real-world open-source verified systems: QBFT (Quorum BFT consensus), DVT (Distributed Validator Technology/Protocol), TrueSat (verified SAT solver), Eth2.0, daisy-nfsd, and an AWS Dafny Encryption SDK library. The remaining specs include two containing artificial bugs from Abreu et al.
验证层次
The trusted specification layer — the part of an IronFleet-style proof that is assumed rather than proven
工具
IronSpec, implemented in Dafny (mutations over the Dafny AST): an Automatic Sanity Checker + automated spec mutation testing + human-written Spec-Testing Proofs (STPs)
自动化判定
半自动 Confirmed. The sanity checker and mutation testing are fully automatic; confirming a suspected spec bug requires the human to write a Spec-Testing Proof in Dafny that Z3 then discharges.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
None in the conventional sense — it flags discrepancies between a spec and developer intent, the failure mode that invalidates otherwise-sound proofs
证明代价
Not reported as a proof:code ratio. Confirmed.
备注
Relevance to a consensus survey is real but indirect: QBFT is a Byzantine consensus protocol and DVT is a distributed validator protocol, so two of the six subject systems are consensus systems — but IronSpec verifies nothing about them, it tests their specs. Positioned as the constructive systems-venue response to Fonseca et al. (EuroSys'17), which found sixteen bugs across IronFleet, Verdi and Chapar. Essential for any TCB critique of IronFleet-style verification.
136AutoMan: Facilitating Verified Distributed Systems Development Through Automatic Code Generation and Manual Optimizations
SOSP 2025 — ACM SIGOPS 31st Symposium on Operating Systems Principles, Seoul; pp. 768-785, DOI 10.1145/3731569.3764822, published 12 October 2025
作者
Zihao Zhang, Ti Zhou, Christa Jenkins, Omar Chowdhury, Shuai Mu (Stony Brook University)
协议
Four artifact case studies: Multi-Paxos (RSL, adapted from IronFleet), a Key-Value Store (KV, adapted from IronFleet), Byzantine Multi-Paxos (ByzRSL, original), plus negative examples that deliberately fail AutoMan's checks. PBFT and RaftKV appear only as unverified performance BASELINES in the evaluation (ByzRSL vs PBFT in Fig. 8; PaxosKV vs RaftKV throughput).
验证层次
end-to-end / executable implementation — generates the implementation layer, abstraction functions and refinement proof skeletons connecting executable code to the TLA-style protocol specification
工具
AutoMan, built on Dafny 3.x with a Z3 backend, following IronFleet; code at github.com/stonysystems/automan
自动化判定
半自动 Deductive verification in the IronFleet/Dafny (SMT-backed) tradition. The human writes the TLA-style protocol specification in Dafny, the refinement invariants and any manual optimizations; AutoMan mechanically generates the implementation layer, abstraction functions and proof skeletons from annotated specs (a '+' / '-' input/output annotation language), and regenerates obligations for hand-writt …
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Refinement of the executable implementation to the protocol-level TLA-style specification, hence safety of the replicated state machine.
证明代价
Motivated by IronFleet's proof:code ratio; the claim is a substantial reduction in manual spec-to-implementation transcription burden while retaining hand-tuned performance. ByzRSL is the one verified BFT system in this space with published throughput numbers.
备注
Content claims (Dafny 3.x, the functionalization mechanism, the case-study list) come from the authors' own GitHub README and artifact README, which is a reliable but secondary source. Conflict-of-interest flag for the survey: this appears to be the survey author's own group's work and the host repository (tla-rs) is its Rust/Verus follow-on — worth an explicit disclosure. The follow-on claims (tla-rs bidirectional TLA+/Verus translation and DPOR model checking; 'Lion: Modular Verification of Async Runtime Liveness' accepted to SOSP 2026) were NOT independently verified.

作者
Tony Nuda Zhang (signs as 'Nuda Zhang', nudzhang@umich.edu, ORCID 0009-0009-0288-8270). Doctoral committee: Associate Professor Manos Kapritsos (Chair), Associate Professor Jean-Baptiste Jeannin, Assistant Professor Yatin Manerkar, Professor Bryan Parno.
协议

140Foundational Multi-Modal Program Verifiers
POPL 2026 — 53rd ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages, Rennes, France, January 2026; Proc. ACM Program. Lang. Vol. 10 (POPL); DOI 10.1145/3776719
作者
Vladimir Gladshtein, George Pîrlea (NUS), Qiyuan Zhao (NUS), Vitaly Kurin (Neapolis University Pafos), Ilya Sergey (NUS)
协议
NOPaxos (network-ordered Paxos) is the flagship distributed case study — the paper's §7.2 is 'Case Study: NOPaxos and Runtime Testing', inside §7 'Combining Runtime and Deductive Verification of Distributed Protocols'. Non-distributed case studies include insertion sort (§8.1) and sparse data computations (§8.2).
验证层次
abstract protocol plus executable semantics — the overhaul gives the model executable semantics so the same artefact can be randomly tested AND deductively verified ('multi-modal')
工具
Loom (monad-transformer-algebra framework shallowly embedded in Lean 4) instantiated as Veil (distributed protocols in FOL) and Velvet (Dafny-style imperative verifier); code at github.com/verse-lab/loom
自动化判定
半自动 Specs, inductive invariants and lemma structure are human-supplied; VCs go to SMT. The novelty is that the verifiers themselves are derived with machine-checked soundness proofs in Lean, and that the same model can be executed/fuzz-tested and model-checked as well as proved — but the invariant burden still sits with the human, so semi-auto.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety of NOPaxos and other protocols; additionally, the soundness of the derived verifiers themselves is machine-checked in Lean.
证明代价
Not reported as a proof:code ratio. The paper reports several non-trivial case studies proved and tested across modes (fuzz-testing, model checking, automated and interactive deductive proof).
备注
Direct successor to Veil (CAV'25). This is the strongest current example of the 'foundational + automated' hybrid for distributed protocols, and the multi-modal angle (same artefact fuzzed, model-checked and proved) is the distinctive claim a survey should record.

3.2 Verus 与 Rust 验证

Verus / Rust — 10 项

Verus 把 IronFleet 的方法搬到 Rust 上,并用线性 ghost 类型处理所有权。对共识验证而言最重要的两项:

  • Anvil(OSDI 2024,最佳论文)——第一个证明活性(Eventually Stable Reconciliation)的可执行 Kubernetes 控制器框架,proof:code 4.5–7.4,每个控制器约 2.5 人月。它证明的不是共识本身,而是建立在共识之上的控制平面,但方法论(TLA 风格时序规约 + Verus)与共识验证同源。
  • Welder(2026,forthcoming)——把 Anvil 的活性验证组合化。

这一节还收了 SMT 证明工程的基础设施工作(Mariposa 的 SMT 不稳定性度量、AutoVerus/ExVerus 的自动证明生成),因为它们直接决定这条路线能不能规模化。

141Mariposa: Measuring SMT Instability in Automated Program Verification
FMCAD 2023 (October 2023); full version also a CMU technical report, DOI 10.1184/R1/23905905
作者
Yi Zhou, Jay Bosamiya, Yoshiki Takashima, Jessica Li, Marijn Heule, Bryan Parno
协议
N/A — the benchmark suite is drawn from large SMT-backed systems-verification projects in this lineage (Dafny, F*, Verus artifacts, including IronFleet-style codebases)
验证层次
The verification pipeline itself: the stability/reproducibility of Z3 queries generated by Dafny/F*/Verus proofs
工具
Mariposa (Z3 query mutation and statistical stability testing) over Dafny, F*, and Verus
自动化判定
半自动 Not a protocol proof: it quantifies how brittle the SMT automation underpinning semi-automated (Dafny/Verus/F*) proofs actually is, by mutating and re-running the solver queries those proofs generate. The automation label is not really applicable to this record.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
None; it measures proof stability (fraction of queries whose success flips under semantically neutral mutations)
证明代价
not reported
备注
75-94, DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-99984-0_5, by Yi Zhou, Amar Shah, Zhengyao Lin, Marijn Heule, Bryan Parno. The other three follow-ons named in the notes (FMCAD 2024 context pruning, SMT-COMP 2025 instability track, and Yi Zhou's May 2025 CMU thesis) were NOT independently re-verified — the web-search budget was exhausted — so treat those secondary citations as unchecked. Central to any honest account of IronFleet-lineage proof cost: it shows a substantial fraction of real Dafny/Verus queries are unstable, the hidden tax behind IronFleet's 39K lines of proof annotation and 6-hour serial builds.

Chanhee Cho, Yi Zhou, Jay Bosamiya, Bryan Parno (CMU)

N/A — tooling paper, evaluated on Dafny and Verus proof developments in the systems-verification lineage. No distributed or consensus protocol is verified.

Proof Actions, an IDE-integrated framework for Dafny and Verus (+ Z3)

143Anvil: Verifying Liveness of Cluster Management Controllers
OSDI 2024, pp. 649-666. Best Paper Award (OSDI's best-paper award is the Jay Lepreau Best Paper Award).
作者
Xudong Sun, Wenjie Ma, Jiawei Tyler Gu, Zicheng Ma (UIUC); Tej Chajed (Wisconsin-Madison); Jon Howell, Andrea Lattuada, Oded Padon (VMware Research); Lalith Suresh (Feldera); Adriana Szekeres (VMware Research); Tianyin Xu (UIUC)
协议
Not a classical consensus protocol. THREE Kubernetes controllers were implemented and verified: a ZooKeeper controller, a RabbitMQ controller, and a FluentBit controller — each reconciling against the asynchronous Kubernetes cluster state.
验证层次
Executable Rust controller implementations proven against a TLA-style temporal specification of the whole cluster, including the asynchronous Kubernetes API server environment and interfering built-in controllers (garbage collector, StatefulSet controller) which are modeled as trusted assumptions
工具
Verus (SMT-backed Rust verifier, Z3) with verus-tla, a TLA embedding descended from IronFleet's TLA-in-Dafny
自动化判定
半自动 Confirmed. Developers hand-write the temporal specification, the leads-to argument chains and the inductive invariants; Verus/Z3 discharge the VCs. The paper notes proving invariants is about 40% of the proof effort and explicitly points to inductive-invariant-inference research as the way to reduce it.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Liveness — 'Eventually Stable Reconciliation' (ESR) — plus supporting safety invariants and one RabbitMQ-specific safety property
证明代价
Verification takes under 3 minutes wall-clock on a 6-core laptop with 11 threads; 87% of proof functions verify in under 10 CPU seconds. Evolution study: 28 new FluentBit features, average 47 lines changed each, of which 19 lines in proof.
备注
The clearest modern continuation of IronFleet's liveness methodology outside Dafny. Verification exposed two real bugs, both confirmed in the paper: a safety issue involving the Kubernetes garbage collector orphaning pods from a stale stateful set, and a liveness bug from an inherited naming rule that is also present in the unverified reference controller. Repo: github.com/anvil-verifier/anvil. Follow-on: Welder (SOSP'26).
144Verifying Concurrent Systems Code (PhD thesis) ⚠︎
Carnegie Mellon University PhD thesis, Technical Report CMU-CS-24-146, August 2024
作者
Travis Hance (advisor: Bryan Parno)
协议
No consensus protocol. Per the official CMU abstract, the thesis is about recovering concurrent separation logic reasoning through an ownership type system (Rust-style) in order to verify complex concurrent systems at scale. The underlying artifacts are VeriBetrKV (crash-safe B^e-tree KV store, OSDI'20), IronSync/Node Replication and SplinterCache (OSDI'23), Leaf (PACMPL 2023) and Verus.

Specification, refinement, concurrent implementation, and type-system/logic foundations — storage and shared-memory concurrency rather than message-passing consensus

Dafny, Linear Dafny, Verus (all Z3-backed)

半自动 The thesis as described by its own abstract is entirely human-structured, SMT-discharged verification. See corrections regarding the claimed fully-automatic SWISS chapter.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立

Functional correctness, crash safety and linearizability of concurrent systems
证明代价
Could not verify the '4:1 / 7:1' figures. The thesis full text was not retrievable (reports-archive.adm.cs.cmu.edu serves only the abstract page over the connections available to me). Treat those ratios as unconfirmed.

Its relevance to a consensus survey is via the shared Verus/Linear Dafny tooling and Hance's co-authorship of Kondo and SWISS, not via its own contributions.
145Verus: A Practical Foundation for Systems Verification
SOSP 2024, pp. 438-454. Distinguished Artifact Award (confirmed on the SIGOPS SOSP 2024 site; the three Best Paper awards that year went to OZZ, LazyLog and FBDetect).
作者
Andrea Lattuada (MPI-SWS), Travis Hance (CMU), Jay Bosamiya (Microsoft Research), Matthias Brun (ETH Zurich), Chanhee Cho (CMU), Hayley LeBlanc (UT Austin), Pranav Srinivasan, Reto Achermann, Tej Chajed, Chris Hawblitzel, Jon Howell, Jacob R. Lorch, Oded Padon, Bryan Parno
协议
Tool paper — NO consensus protocol is verified. Five case studies: a Verus port of IronFleet's IronKV (a sharded key-value store, not a consensus protocol), the Node Replication (NR) concurrency library from IronSync, an OS page table, a crash-safe storage system, and a concurrent memory allocator. A small distributed lock is used to evaluate distributed protocol reasoning (via EPR mode).
验证层次
The verification substrate itself: executable Rust with linear/ghost types, spec/proof/exec function separation, and an SMT back end — the layer on which IronFleet-style distributed proofs are now being rebuilt

Verus (Rust + Z3), successor to Dafny/Linear Dafny for systems verification
自动化判定
半自动 Confirmed. Humans write specs, invariants and lemma structure in proof fns; Z3 discharges VCs. The contribution is making that loop fast and predictable (per-function SMT contexts, linear ghost state, and an EPR mode for the decidable fragment).
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准

Functional correctness and memory safety of systems code; temporal properties come only via downstream embeddings such as Anvil's verus-tla, not from this paper
证明代价
Case studies total 6.1K lines of implementation and 31K lines of proof (roughly 5:1 aggregate). Headline claim: Verus 'verifies code 3-61x faster and with less effort than the state of the art.' Hyperkernel's 0.03:1 ratio is cited as a contrasting low-ratio point.
备注
IronKV Figure 10 confirmed: the Verus port performs comparably to the IronFleet Dafny original, with payload size currently limited to 512 bytes. Porting improvements confirmed in the text: a hand-written replacement marshalling library, and &mut references replacing whole-structure copies via ownership reasoning. Predecessor: 'Verus: Verifying Rust Programs using Linear Ghost Types' (PACMPL/OOPSLA 2023). Adjacent tool paper, but load-bearing: Anvil and the tla-rs port both build on it.

3.3 Ivy 与 EPR 可判定片段

Ivy / EPR — 21 项

Ivy 这条线的核心洞见是:把协议模型限制在一阶逻辑的 EPR(Effectively Propositional)可判定片段里,SMT 求解器就永远不会超时或给出不可理解的失败。代价是建模时必须刻意避开函数嵌套和量词交替。

  • Ivy(PLDI 2016) 提出交互式泛化:用户看反例(CTI)、给出泛化,工具补全不变式。
  • Paxos made EPR(OOPSLA 2017) 是这条线的代表作,用 EPR 一次性覆盖 Paxos、Multi-Paxos、Vertical Paxos、Fast Paxos、Flexible Paxos、Stoppable Paxos 六个变体,每个变体的不变式检查只要 1–5 秒。但作者明确说明:只验证协议设计,不验证实现。
  • Modularity for Decidability(PLDI 2018) 处理"分解成可判定片段"的模块化问题。
  • 活性:Reducing Liveness to Safety(POPL 2018)与 Temporal Prophecy(FMCAD 2018)把时序性质规约到一阶安全性;LVR(2024)进一步自动化。
  • 落到真实协议:HotStuff(FORTE 2021)、Tendermint(2020–2021 的 Ivy 证明仓库)、Stellar SCP、Moonshot。QUIC 的 Ivy 规约(2019)虽不是共识,但是"用 Ivy 规约驱动真实实现测试"的重要方法论范例。

151Ivy: safety verification by interactive generalization
PLDI 2016 — Proceedings of the 37th ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation, pp. 614–630, DOI 10.1145/2908080.2908118. Also issued as ACM SIGPLAN Notices 51(6).
作者
Oded Padon, Kenneth L. McMillan, Aurojit Panda, Mooly Sagiv, Sharon Shoham
协议
SIX case studies (Table 1), all small distributed protocols — no consensus protocol: (1) leader election in a ring, (2) lock server, (3) distributed lock protocol, (4) learning switch, (5) database chain replication, (6) Chord ring maintenance.
验证层次
Abstract protocol / transition-system safety only. Models written in RML; no executable code, no refinement, no implementation.
工具
Ivy + Z3. RML (Relational Modeling Language, inspired by Alloy) is deliberately restricted so that (a) checking inductiveness of a universal invariant and (b) …
自动化判定
半自动 CONFIRMED. The human supplies the inductive invariant. When induction fails, Ivy displays a minimal concrete counterexample-to-induction (CTI) as a graph; the user selects a graphical upper-bound generalization, Ivy then computes a v-smallest k-invariant generalization via a minimal UNSAT core and proposes the resulting conjecture, and the user decides whether to accept it. …
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety only, via universally quantified inductive invariants.
证明代价
No person-time reported. Table 1 reports per-protocol sorts (1–5), relations/functions (5–13), conjectures in the final invariant (3–35), CTI iterations (12–46) and user generalization steps (3–12). Chord ring maintenance is the largest at 35 conjectures / 46 iterations.
备注
CORRECTED (protocol list). 614–630, DOI 10.1145/2908080.2908118, five authors as listed. Caveat worth carrying into the survey: RML is described as Turing-complete and suitable for infinite-state systems — the restriction is on the shape of the verification conditions, not on expressiveness per se. The Chord case study is where Ivy's interaction actually paid off (it exposed a real modelling problem).

Auxiliary-invariant check 0.7–1.0 s; rewrite-condition check 0.5–0.6 s. Semi-bounded FOL verification degrades badly as the round bound grows: at bound 16, five of six variants time out in 7–10 of 10 runs at the 300 s limit. …

The derived-relations device and the EPR quorum-intersection axiom are confirmed as the core technique. | arXiv:1710.07191 confirms the exact title, all four authors, the '61 pages. …

Also note the paper's caveat that vard and etcd persist to disk (partially mitigated by disabling vard's disk writes and putting etcd on a RAM disk), so the throughput comparison is not apples-to-apples.

Oded Padon, Jochen Hoenicke, Kenneth L. McMillan, Andreas Podelski, Mooly Sagiv, Sharon Shoham
协议
THREE case studies, and NONE is a consensus protocol: (1) Ticket mutual-exclusion protocol with task queues, (2) Alternating Bit Protocol, (3) TLB Shootdown (the Mach TLB-consistency algorithm). No Paxos.
验证层次
Abstract protocol liveness / temporal properties. No implementation.
工具
Ivy, extended with temporal prophecy variables introduced via a tableau construction over FO-LTL formulas; VCs discharged by Z3 and confirmed to lie in a decidable (stratified-EPR) fragment for all examples.
自动化判定
半自动 CONFIRMED. Prophecy formulas refine the system so the liveness-to-safety reduction becomes precise, but the human supplies the temporal prophecy formulas, the prophecy witnesses, and the inductive invariant of the resulting safety problem. The paper's §6 says the safety property 'is proven by a suitable inductive invariant, provided by the user'. The SMT solver only discharges VCs.
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Liveness / temporal properties, with increased precision over the plain liveness-to-safety reduction (which is inherently imprecise for infinite-state systems). Safety of the reduced system as the vehicle.
证明代价
REPORTED (Fig. Per protocol — prophecy formulas / prophecy witnesses / model LOC in Ivy / invariant conjectures / fraction of conjectures using temporal formulas / VC-check time: Ticket w/ Task Queues 1/2/90/60/22%/9.4 s; Alternating Bit Protocol 4/1/143/70/40%/32 s; TLB Shootdown 6/3/468/102/49%/283 s. Measured on a Core-i7 1.8 GHz laptop with Z3 4.6.0. No person-time reported.
备注
CORRECTED, and the correction matters for a consensus survey. Paxos does not appear among the case studies. The examples were chosen precisely because they were beyond reach of the POPL'18 liveness-to-safety transformation. Notably, for TLB shootdown, temporal prophecy witnesses ELIMINATE the non-stratified quantifier alternation that the POPL'18 nesting-structure proof required — that is the concrete technical payoff. 40–53, DOI 10.1007/978-3-032-13711-1_3, 2026, in the festschrift 'On the Pursuit of Insight and Elegance' — note it is a festschrift chapter, not an arXiv-only 2024 item.

THREE frameworks, none of them ByMC: (1) TLA+ specifications checked with TLC (Toolbox 1.7.1) and the symbolic SMT-based model checker Apalache 0.15.0; (2) counter automata checked with FAST, whose input language is Presburger arithmetic; (3) …

半自动 CORRECTED from 'auto'. The results that actually cover arbitrary time bounds come from IVy, where the authors write the inductive invariants by hand: 'both properties are verified by developing inductive invariants with IVy'. The specifications are explicitly NOT in IVy's decidable fragment (an interpreted '+' is applied to a universally quantified variable), and the liveness-to-safety reduction i …
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立

证明代价
IVy (Table 4, arbitrary Delta and Phi): specification sizes 183-207 LOC; inductive invariants 30-129 lines; 0-15 user-supplied strengthening steps; IVy runtimes 4 s, 4 s, 8 s, 22 s, 44 s. The authors report it took about 4 weeks to learn IVy from scratch and complete these proofs. FAST could not prove Strong Accuracy for arbitrary Phi and crashed after 30 minutes. TLC/Apalache experiments run on a Core i7-6600U with 8 GB.
备注
CORRECTED, and this record had the most factual drift of the seven. The real methodological story - worth keeping for the survey - is a three-way comparison of TLA+ model checkers, counter automata, and an SMT-backed prover on one algorithm, with the honest finding that only the theorem prover reaches parametric time bounds and that doing so costs hand-written inductive invariants. The authors also note that proving these with TLAPS would require MORE human effort than with IVy, which is a useful data point on ITP-vs-SMT effort.

Strategically relevant to the survey: aimed squarely at bringing Paxos/Raft invariants inside the reach of fully-automatic inference tools (DistAI/DuoAI/IC3PO/SWISS class). This is now a first-class published entry for the survey's deductive/invariant-decomposition thread.

3.4 TLA+ / TLAPS 演绎证明

TLA+ / TLAPS — 11 项

TLA+ 有两套用法,必须分开看:TLC/Apalache 做模型检验(纯自动、有界) 归第三类,TLAPS 写演绎证明(半自动、无界) 归这里。

TLAPS 的代表工作是 Lamport 自己的 "Byzantizing Paxos by Refinement"(DISC 2011)——用精化把 Byzantine Paxos 归约到普通 Paxos,是这个领域最优雅的证明结构之一。此外还有 Multi-Paxos 的完整 TLAPS 证明(2016)、MongoDB 动态重配置协议的 TLAPS 证明(2022)、以及 DAG 类共识的可复用 TLAPS 框架(2025)。

TLAPS 的现实困境是证明代价高而工具支持弱:后端由 Zenon/Isabelle/SMT 拼成,失败信息差,规模化不如 Dafny/Ivy。近两年的 LLM 辅助工作(见 §4.8 LLM 与学习驱动的自动化)相当集中地瞄准了这个痛点。

Good bridge case for an automation taxonomy: it sits deliberately between automatic invariant inference and hand-written TLAPS proof, and the localized-counterexample/variable-slicing mechanism is the concrete thing that makes it more automated than plain TLAPS.

3.5 Event-B / CIVL / Move Prover / PSync 及其他 SMT 后端框架

Event-B, CIVL, Move Prover, PSync, other SMT-backed frameworks — 23 项

一批不属于上述主流工具、但方法论上各有独到之处的框架:

  • PSync(POPL 2016)与 Consensus Logic CL(2014):为部分同步的轮次型算法设计专用 DSL 与可判定逻辑,让不变式检查落进可判定片段。
  • 通信封闭化归约(Communication-Closed / Pretend Synchrony / Inductive Sequentialization,2019–2020):把异步程序归约成同步轮次,再验证同步版本——这是"降低验证难度"的另一条正交思路,PLDI/CAV/POPL 都有产出。
  • CIVL、Event-B/Rodin(PBFT、Paxos 的精化式构造)、Move Prover(CAV 2020)(Diem/Aptos 智能合约,含共识相关不变式)。
  • Veil(CAV 2025):Lean 4 + SMT,试图在同一个框架里同时提供自动化与交互式回退——是 Ivy 与 Coq 之间的一次架构折中。

183Automated Verification of a Randomized Distributed Consensus Protocol Using Cadence SMV and PRISM
CAV 2001 (13th Intl. Conference on Computer Aided Verification), eds. Berry, Comon, Finkel, LNCS 2102, pp. 194-206, Paris, France, July 2001, Springer
作者
Marta Z. Kwiatkowska, Gethin Norman, Roberto Segala
协议
Aspnes-Herlihy randomized consensus for N asynchronous processes communicating via read/write shared registers, tolerating stopping failures; plus its shared coin-flipping (collective random walk) subprotocol CF parameterized by N and a constant K > 1
验证层次
Abstract protocol layer only. Split into a non-probabilistic part (Validity, Agreement, and non-probabilistic progress invariants), verified for all N and all rounds in Cadence SMV, and a probabilistic part (the shared coin protocol CF), verified in PRISM for fixed finite configurations. …
工具
Cadence SMV (McMillan's compositional model checker used as a proof assistant: ordset data-type reduction, temporal case splitting, circular compositional reasoning, induction) for the non-probabilistic part; PRISM (MTBDD engine, PCTL over MDPs) …
自动化判定
半自动 CORRECTED from 'auto'. The Cadence SMV half is emphatically human-driven: the authors write approximately 50 lemmas plus explicit subcase/case-split directives on round[i], 'using' assumptions, and manual freeing of variables ('Judicious choice of data reduction/freeing is important, as otherwise SMV may return false'). Each individual lemma is then discharged automatically by model checking. …
保证强度
无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Cadence SMV, for all N and all rounds: Validity, Agreement, and the two non-probabilistic progress invariants (Invariant 1: max round does not increase by more than 1 without reaching F_0 u F_1 u D; Invariant 2). PRISM, for finite configurations: C1, that from any reachable state of CF_r all processes leave with probability 1 (qualitative); …
证明代价
Cadence SMV proof consists of approximately 50 lemmas, requiring at most 270 MB of memory. PRISM (3.3GHz Intel Core, 4GB) results: N=2/K=64, 8,208 states, C2 in 3,689 s; N=4/K=32, 329,856 states, 212,784 s; N=8/K=16, 4.37e8 states, 1,085,300 s; N=10/K=8, 1.0e10 states, 986,424 s. No person-months or proof:code ratio reported.
备注
CORRECTED: PRISM part is bounded to N up to 10 processes (not just 'modest N'); K is a protocol constant varied 64/32/16/8, not held fixed. Correct that this is the first mechanical verification of a complex randomized distributed algorithm (the paper claims this itself), and it does follow the fully manual Pogosyants-Segala-Lynch proof of the same algorithm (Distributed Computing 13(3):155-186, 2000), so the manual-vs-mechanized pairing the survey wants is real. …

协议
Threshold-guarded fault-tolerant broadcast: several variants of the Srikanth-Toueg algorithm under four fault models (Byzantine, symmetric, omission, clean crash), plus the folklore reliable broadcast algorithm RBC also considered by Fisman et al. …

Abstract protocol layer, parameterized in n, t and f under an arithmetic resilience condition

无界证明 结论对任意节点数/任意执行成立
证明的性质
Safety - unforgeability (U) and correctness (C) - and liveness - relay (R), handled via justice requirements and a refinement that removes loops through unjust states - for all n, t, f satisfying the resilience condition. Tool runtimes/memory only, on a 3.3 GHz Intel Core with 4 GB. Refinement steps range 0-43. No LOC or person-months.
备注
CORRECTED protocol scope - this is the important survey-level fix. The paper covers Srikanth-Toueg broadcast variants across four fault models plus folklore RBC. It does NOT cover Bracha-style broadcast or general asynchronous Byzantine agreement primitives; those appear in the later ByMC papers (CAV 2015 / FMSD 2017). It is correctly described as the first paper to achieve parameterized automated verification of a Byzantine FTDA. 201-209, DOI 10.1109/FMCAD.2013.6679411. IEEE and the group's site were unreachable), so the benchmark table must be checked before publishing the algorithm list. …

The lineage claims are consistent with the other records verified in this batch: this is the logical ancestor of PSync (POPL 2016, same CL fragment lifted into a language with a runtime), and it predates Paxos Made EPR by three years, supporting its billing as the earliest serious decidable logic designed specifically for consensus.
