339CMC: A Pragmatic Approach to Model Checking Real Code
OSDI 2002 (5th USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation), Boston, MA, Dec 9-11 2002; also ACM SIGOPS Operating Systems Review 36(SI), pp. 75-88, DOI 10.1145/844128.844136 (proceedings DOI 10.1145/1060289.1060297)
作者
Madanlal Musuvathi, David Y. W. Park, Andy Chou, Dawson R. Engler, David L. Dill
协议
AODV (Ad-hoc On-demand Distance Vector routing) — three independent C implementations: mad-hoc v1.0 (~5,500 LOC), Kernel AODV v1.5 / NIST (~7,500 LOC), AODV-UU v0.5 (~7,700 LOC). Not a consensus protocol, but the founding paper of implementation-level model checking that later consensus dmcks build on.
验证层次
executable implementation (unmodified C source, run inside the checker)
工具
CMC (C Model Checker)
自动化判定
纯自动 Human writes (a) an environment model stubbing the OS/network API, (b) C-language invariants/assertions, and (c) a state-canonicalization hint. CMC then performs exhaustive explicit-state search with state hashing and heap canonicalization. No inductive invariant is supplied. Bounded and unsound (hash-table- and depth-limited) but fully automatic in the survey's sense.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing is proven. Checked: generic memory-safety/assertion failures, memory leaks (unreachable-heap detection per state), plus AODV-specific routing-table invariants (loop-freedom, no route to self, sequence-number monotonicity). 'No route to self in the AODV-UU implementation' appears verbatim in the results.
证明代价
No proof; effort is environment-modelling effort. One AODV environment model reused with minor modifications across all three implementations.
备注
34 distinct errors across three AODV implementations (Kernel AODV alone had 5), one of which is a defect in the AODV specification. Mechanisms later inherited by every distributed model checker: run the real C code as the model; hash a canonicalized state signature; nondeterministic environment via CMCChoose; abstraction by excluding memory regions from the signature. SCOPE CAVEAT for the survey: this is routing-protocol correctness, not consensus — keep it as founding-era context, not as a consensus-verification data point.
340Model Checking Large Network Protocol Implementations
NSDI 2004 (1st USENIX Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation), San Francisco, CA
作者
Madanlal Musuvathi, Dawson R. Engler
协议
Linux TCP/IP kernel implementation (~50K lines of relevant kernel code), checked with two application threads acting as TCP client and server plus a network thread and a timer thread. Not consensus; the paper that showed implementation-level model checking scales to production network stacks.
验证层次
executable implementation (the real Linux kernel TCP code, run in user space inside the checker)
工具
CMC
自动化判定
纯自动 Human supplies a test environment at the syscall + hardware-abstraction interface and a TCP reference model for conformance checking; CMC does the systematic exploration. No inductive invariant. Automatic heap canonicalization relocates dynamically allocated objects to canonical positions and rewrites pointers, so the abstraction need not be specified manually.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing proven. Checked: deadlock states, memory-safety and leak assertions, and protocol conformance against a hand-written TCP reference model — every implementation transition must be permitted by the reference model. …
证明代价
Environment/harness effort: reused an existing user-space Linux kernel port; the TCP reference model used for conformance checking is ~500 lines of C. ~20 ms per transition (dropping to <4 ms with a >5x reduction technique); the authors state CMC can run for weeks on a gigabyte hash table without exhausting memory. Checked state is ~250KB per state.
备注
Four errors in the Linux TCP implementation. Contributions relevant to the survey: (i) automatic heap canonicalization; (ii) automatic detection/abstraction of state components taking too many distinct values; (iii) running an entire OS kernel as one model-checked process. Worth adding for honesty: the reference model itself was debugged iteratively, so the 'conformance' oracle is not independent ground truth. SCOPE CAVEAT: network-protocol, not consensus.
341Life, Death, and the Critical Transition: Finding Liveness Bugs in Systems Code
USENIX NSDI 2007 (Awarded Best Paper)
协议
Mace implementations of Pastry, Chord, a reliable transport protocol (MaceTransport), and an overlay tree (RandTree). No consensus protocol is among the subjects.
验证层次
Executable implementation. MaceMC model-checks the running C++ implementations produced by the Mace compiler, not abstract specifications.
工具
MaceMC (software model checker), combining bounded exhaustive search from the initial state with long random walks, plus critical-transition isolation and the MDB debugger
自动化判定
纯自动 The developer writes only high-level liveness state predicates ("eventually all nodes form a ring") plus safety assertions; MaceMC finds violating executions by exhaustive-then-random search and automatically localizes the critical transition. No invariants, no proof steps.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Liveness violations (via the "dead state" approximation: states from which the liveness predicate can never be satisfied regardless of subsequent actions) and safety violations. Heuristic and incomplete by construction, since true liveness requires infinite executions.
证明代价
not reported; 52 bugs found across four systems (33 across the three mature systems, spanning ~1500 LOC of Mace protocol code)
备注
First systems-venue work to attack liveness rather than safety in distributed implementations; the "critical transition" concept (the step that moves the system from recoverable to dead) is its central contribution and is what makes the counterexamples debuggable. Fills the empirical/systems side of the survey's otherwise proof-only liveness coverage (IronFleet, Performal, Anvil, LiDO). (2) Death — restrict to dead states from which liveness can never be achieved, reducing liveness to searching for violations of previously unknown safety properties; (3) …
342Mace: Language Support for Building Distributed Systems
PLDI 2007, pp. 179-188
协议
Overlay and distributed protocols implemented in Mace - Chord, Pastry, RandTree overlay, a reliable transport protocol (not consensus protocols per se)
验证层次
Executable implementation generated from a restricted state-machine specification. A C++ language extension plus source-to-source compiler translates a concise distributed-system specification into a C++ implementation; the imposed structure is what makes efficient model checking and causal-path debugging of the real implementation possible.
工具
Mace compiler (C++ source-to-source), with the MaceMC model checker and causal-path debugging built on the generated structure
自动化判定
纯自动 The programmer writes the protocol as a structured state machine and the properties to check; correctness checking is done by exhaustive/heuristic state-space exploration of the compiled implementation with no invariants or proof obligations.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Safety properties over the generated implementation, plus (via MaceMC) liveness predicates. All checking is bounded exploration, not proof.
证明代价
not reported
备注
Methodological ancestor of DSLabs, and the direct predecessor of the "write the protocol in a restricted language, then check/compile the implementation" approach shared by PGo and AutoMan. This is the enabling infrastructure for the whole Mace line (MaceMC, CrystalBall, LMC, DEMETER-MaceMC), and its relevance to consensus verification is indirect — it made Paxos implementations checkable by CrystalBall, LMC and DEMETER. If the survey needs a citation for 'Paxos in Mace', cite CrystalBall/LMC/DEMETER, not this paper. PDF: https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~jwanderson/mace-pldi07.pdf
343WiDS Checker: Combating Bugs in Distributed Systems
NSDI 2007 (4th USENIX Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation), Cambridge, MA, April 2007
作者
Xuezheng Liu, Wei Lin, Aimin Pan, Zheng Zhang (all Microsoft Research Asia)
协议
Four targets: a Paxos implementation, the Boxwood distributed lock service, the BitVault storage system, and Macedon-Chord.
验证层次
executable implementation (checks both simulated runs and replayed traces from real deployment)
工具
WiDS Checker
自动化判定
纯自动 The developer writes assertions in a predicate script language over global state reconstructed via happens-before; the checker replays/simulates and flags violations. No inductive invariant. Strictly this is trace checking + simulation rather than exhaustive search, so 'auto' but weaker than MODIST-class exhaustive dmcks — the survey should not treat it as an exhaustive explorer.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
None proven. Checked: developer-refined system properties expressed as predicate-script assertions over reconstructed global state (for Paxos, the agreement property).
证明代价
No proofs. Assertion-writing effort is small and is reported per target: 29 lines of predicate script for Paxos, 33 for the Boxwood lock server, 181 for BitVault, 86 for Macedon-Chord. Tool implementation ~4K LOC (replay) + ~7K LOC (checker).
备注
Historically the first MSR Asia implementation-level checker and the direct ancestor of MODIST. Its headline survey data point is now solid: model checking the code found a flaw in a Paxos specification that had been considered proven, and the specification's authors confirmed it. All instances of the distributed system run in one simulation process, so the checker observes the true happens-before order and can reconstruct full global state. Note the 29-line Paxos predicate script is a genuinely useful 'automatic checking is cheap to set up' number for the survey. Verified full text via https://www.usenix.org/leg …
344CrystalBall: Predicting and Preventing Inconsistencies in Deployed Distributed Systems
NSDI 2009 (6th USENIX Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation), Boston, MA, April 2009
作者
Maysam Yabandeh, Nikola Knezevic, Dejan Kostic, Viktor Kuncak (EPFL)
协议
PAXOS (a Mace Paxos implementation with leader/acceptor/learner roles co-located per node), plus RandTree, Bullet' (BulletPrime) and Chord.
验证层次
executable implementation, checked online in a live deployment — arguably end-to-end system, since execution steering does not merely detect but steers the running system away from predicted violations
工具
CrystalBall (built on Mace/MaceMC)
自动化判定
纯自动 Each live node continuously runs 'consequence prediction' on a recent consistent snapshot of its neighborhood, checking developer-specified safety properties. For Paxos the developer writes only the classical agreement property — 'at most one value can be chosen, across all nodes' — and nothing else. No inductive invariant, no proof; fully automatic search.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
None proven. For Paxos, the classical agreement property (at most one value chosen). Previously unknown bugs found in three mature Mace implementations (RandTree, Bullet', Chord) that had survived exhaustive model checking and manual debugging; Paxos was used for the execution-steering evaluation with two injected realistic bugs.
证明代价
No proofs. What is reported is runtime cost, not proof effort: consequence prediction must complete within the snapshot-exchange period. Evaluated on 20 Linux machines emulating up to 100 logical end hosts, 5,000-node INET topology, ~130 ms average RTT.
备注
Earliest "verification at runtime" work for deployed distributed systems and the intellectual ancestor of the NSDI 2025 Runtime Protocol Refinement Checking line. Bug1 is the 'Paxos Made Live'-style error producing two different chosen values in one instance; bug2 concerns an acceptor failing to keep a promise across a crash. Genuinely the first work to move automatic implementation-level checking of a consensus protocol from offline testing into the live system — that framing survives fact-checking. Verified full text via https://www.usenix.org/legacy/event/nsdi09/tech/full_papers/yabandeh/yabandeh.pdf
345MODIST: Transparent Model Checking of Unmodified Distributed Systems
USENIX NSDI 2009, pp. 213-228
协议
MPS - a deployed Paxos implementation; PacificA primary-backup replication protocol; Berkeley DB replication
验证层次
Executable implementation, unmodified. A thin interposition layer under the unmodified binaries on an unmodified OS exposes all actions to a centralized, OS-independent model-checking engine; no rewriting or annotation of the target system is required.
工具
MODIST (custom model checker for Windows) with an execution engine simulating consistent deterministic executions and failures, a virtual-clock mechanism to avoid false positives/negatives from timeouts, and a heuristic state-exploration framework
自动化判定
纯自动 Fully push-button on unmodified binaries: the human supplies only the workload and checks (assertions/hangs); MODIST systematically enumerates message reorderings, partitions and crashes with no invariant, model, or annotation burden.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Safety (assertion violations, crashes, data-consistency violations) and hang/liveness-style failures, over bounded explorations. No proof of correctness.
证明代价
not reported (bug-finding tool)
备注
Found 35 bugs in total across the three well-tested production systems, including 10 protocol-level bugs (flaws in the core distributed protocols): 2 in Berkeley DB, 2 in the MPS Paxos implementation, and 6 in PacificA. This is the founding work for implementation-level model checking of consensus code, and the ancestor of SAMC, FlyMC, SandTable, and model-checking-guided testing. | MPS protocol bug 1 (verified in detail): replica A leaves the learning state via a quorum response from B, enters stable; C (the primary) responds late; the implementation handles the delayed message as if A were still learning; …
346dBug: Systematic Evaluation of Distributed Systems (SSV 2010) / dBug: Systematic Testing of Unmodified Distributed and Multi-Threaded Systems (SPIN 2011)
SSV 2010 (5th International Workshop on Systems Software Verification), Vancouver, Oct 6-7 2010, USENIX; extended as SPIN 2011, LNCS 6823, pp. 188-193, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-22306-8_14. Follow-up: 'Scalable Dynamic Partial Order Reduction', RV 2012 (LNCS 7687, pp. 19-34, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-35632-2_4), by Simsa, Bryant, Gibson AND Jason Hickey.
作者
Jiri Simsa, Randal E. Bryant, Garth A. Gibson — for BOTH the SSV 2010 and the SPIN 2011 papers. Jason Hickey is NOT an author of either; he is a coauthor only of the later RV 2012 paper.
协议
General distributed/multithreaded systems using POSIX threads and sockets. Concrete SSV 2010 case studies: PVFS (Parallel Virtual File System) and FAWN-KV. No named consensus protocol; dBug is cited by SAMC as the dmck that applies DPOR the way MODIST does.
验证层次
executable implementation (unmodified binaries, via interposition on POSIX process-management, pthreads, semaphore and socket calls)
工具
dBug
自动化判定
纯自动 Given a system, an initial state and a workload, dBug systematically enumerates possible orders of concurrent events, optionally applying dynamic partial-order reduction to skip equivalent interleavings. The human supplies only the workload, manual instrumentation and a correctness check. No inductive invariant.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Bounded exhaustiveness for a fixed workload and initial state (all interleavings), not a general correctness proof. Correctness checks are user-supplied assertions; deadlock detection and non-reentrant-call conflicts are built in.
证明代价
No proofs, and no effort figures reported. The notable claim, confirmed: given a correctness check, dBug can verify that all possible serializations of a given concurrent workload execute correctly — exhaustive for a fixed bounded workload. The SSV 2010 evaluation reports substantial runtime overhead; one two-concurrent-create experiment on PVFS reduces to 407 distinct serializations under partial-order reduction.
备注
Included as a founding-era dmck and as the DPOR-based point of comparison in SAMC's related work. Also note dBug relies on MANUAL instrumentation in the SSV 2010 version (the paper's own phrasing: 'leverages manual instrumentation'), which is weaker than the 'unmodified systems' framing of the SPIN 2011 title; the survey should not overstate its transparency relative to MODIST. Project page: https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~jsimsa/dbug/
347Model Checking a Networked System Without the Network
NSDI 2011 (8th USENIX Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation), Boston, MA
作者
Rachid Guerraoui, Maysam Yabandeh (EPFL)
协议
PAXOS and 1Paxos — 1Paxos is a Multi-Paxos variant running with a single active acceptor, replaced by a backup on failure, using a separate PaxosUtility consensus instance to identify the global leader and active acceptor.
验证层次
executable implementation (Mace C++ code, checked online via CrystalBall)
工具
LMC (local model checking), built by modifying MaceMC; driven online by CrystalBall
自动化判定
纯自动 The insight is a search optimization: drop the network from the stored state, explore each node's local state space separately, then check a-posteriori whether a combination of local states is jointly reachable. The user supplies a test driver and safety properties; the tool searches. No invariant, no proof.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing proven. The authors are explicit that the local approach does not eliminate exponential state explosion, only postpones it — 'good enough' for online checkers that restart periodically from the live state. …
证明代价
No proofs. Performance figures (corrected): global exploration of Paxos with 3 nodes and one proposal takes 1,514 s; LMC-OPT ~189 ms, LMC-GEN 5.16 s. The new 1Paxos bug was found in 225 s.
备注
Implementation details confirmed: hashes of serialized per-node states in a set, with serialized state kept in a deque for random access; each message tracks how many node states it has been applied to, so each round only tests messages against newly added states. Reuses MaceMC's auto-generated (de)serialization for Mace module state plus new save/restore for the whole multi-layer service stack (needed because 1Paxos layers on Paxos). Verified full text via https://www.usenix.org/legacy/event/nsdi11/tech/full_papers/Guerraoui.pdf
348Practical Software Model Checking via Dynamic Interface Reduction
SOSP 2011 (23rd ACM Symposium on Operating Systems Principles), Cascais, Portugal, pages 265-278, DOI 10.1145/2043556.2043582
作者
Huayang Guo, Ming Wu, Lidong Zhou, Gang Hu, Junfeng Yang, Lintao Zhang
协议
PAXOS twice over: (a) MPS, the deployed Microsoft production Paxos implementation (~53K LOC), via DEMETER-MODIST; (b) PAM, an unoptimized single-decision Paxos implementation in Mace written independently by a student, via DEMETER-MaceMC. Also Berkeley DB, Chord, Pastry.
验证层次
executable implementation
工具
DEMETER, integrated into both MaceMC and MODIST (~1,000 LOC of changes to each)
自动化判定
纯自动 Dynamic interface reduction decomposes global exploration into per-component local exploration plus interface-behavior matching; entirely a search-reduction technique. The human supplies bounds (ballot numbers bounded to 2, decree numbers to 1) and assertions, not invariants.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing proven logically, but this is the closest the implementation-level line gets to a coverage claim: for MPS with ballots bounded to 2 and decrees to 1, DEMETER completely explored a logically meaningful state space covering both phases of Paxos — 'basic implementation-level protocol behaviors have now been "verified"' (their scare quotes). …
证明代价
Integration effort explicitly reported: ~1,000 lines of code changed in each of MaceMC and MODIST. Exploration: Chord 3 hours / 17,384 local traces / 27,588,408 global traces (>2 months for plain MaceMC); MPS 18 hours / 182,689 local traces / 7,743,820,726 global traces (~34 years for plain MODIST). Effective speedup for MPS-3 exceeds 10^5.
备注
(2) incorrect vote message — on receiving accepted values in phase 1 the leader must vote in phase 2 for the accepted value with the highest ballot number, but the implementation chose the first received value; surfaces only when two different values were accepted on two nodes, depth 43. The honest negative result is real and quotable: 'Bug finding turns out to be significantly different from covering a state space.' The strongest bounded-coverage claim in the implementation-level bucket.
349Jepsen (distributed systems safety analysis practice; Knossos and Elle checkers)
PRACTICE-ONLY — technical reports at jepsen.io/analyses plus conference talks; not peer-reviewed. The only peer-reviewed core is Elle (PVLDB 14(3), 2020). Cite individual analyses by report URL and date.
作者
Kyle Kingsbury (Jepsen LLC), with Peter Alvaro on the Elle work
协议
Consensus and consensus-backed systems. ZooKeeper 3.4.5 (2013-09-23); MongoDB (five analyses, 2013-2020); RethinkDB 2.1.5 (2016-01-04) and 2.2.3 (2016-01-22); Cassandra 2.0.0 (2013-09-24); TiDB 2.1.7 (2019-06-12); CockroachDB (2017-02-16); YugaByte DB (2019-03-26, 2019-09-05); Redis-Raft (2020-06-23); Tendermint (2017-09-05); TigerBeetle 0.16.11 (2025-06-06); jetcd 0.8.2 (2024-08-08); …
验证层次
end-to-end system (opaque-box: real binaries on real clusters, real partitions and clock skew via nemesis processes; only client-observable histories analyzed)
工具
Jepsen (Clojure), with Knossos (linearizability, descended from Gavin Lowe's algorithm) and Elle (transactional isolation) as checkers
自动化判定
纯自动 Jepsen states explicitly: 'tests are nondeterministic, and we cannot prove correctness, only find errors.'
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing proven. Falsification only. Jepsen states its own limitation directly: 'we sacrifice some of the strengths of formal methods: tests are nondeterministic, and we cannot prove correctness, only find errors.'
证明代价
No proofs. Verified near-verbatim from jepsen.io/analyses: 'Since 2013, Jepsen has analyzed over two dozen databases, coordination services, and queues—and we've found replica divergence, data loss, stale reads, read skew, lock conflicts, and much more.' The relevant effort metric is human-days of consulting per analysis, not proof:code ratio.
备注
The report also corrected etcd's own documentation, which had claimed only sequential consistency.
350P: Safe Asynchronous Event-Driven Programming
PLDI 2013 — Proceedings of the 34th ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation, pp. 321-332 (also ACM SIGPLAN Notices 48(6)), DOI 10.1145/2491956.2462184
作者
Ankush Desai, Vivek Gupta, Ethan Jackson, Shaz Qadeer, Sriram Rajamani, Damien Zufferey
协议
Not consensus-specific at origin (Windows USB 3.0 device drivers), but P became the vehicle for AWS's modelling of S3 strong-consistency index protocols, EBS, DynamoDB, MemoryDB, Aurora, EC2, and the IoT/FreeRTOS OTA update protocol
验证层次
abstract protocol/design expressed as communicating state machines; P programs are also compilable to executable code
工具
P language plus systematic (model-checking) exploration of state-machine schedules; environment modelled as nondeterministic ghost machines
自动化判定
纯自动 Confirmed. The developer writes state machines plus safety and liveness monitors; the P checker systematically explores schedules. No inductive invariants are supplied.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Safety monitors and liveness (lasso-detection) monitors over asynchronous event-driven systems, on bounded configurations. Confirmed.
证明代价
Not reported for consensus applications — confirmed.
备注
Windows USB 3.0 device drivers as the original application; and DRONA (safe robotics, UC Berkeley) and PSec (secure distributed systems with Intel SGX, UC Berkeley). THE '3 BUGS' CLAIM IS CONFIRMED: the Amazon IoT OTA case study (OTA update for AWS FreeRTOS devices) is the only P case study reporting a specific defect count, and it reports 3 bugs found during modelling that pointed to potential issues in the actual implementation.
351SAMC: Semantic-Aware Model Checking for Fast Discovery of Deep Bugs in Cloud Systems
OSDI 2014 (11th USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation), pp. 399-414
作者
Tanakorn Leesatapornwongsa, Mingzhe Hao, Pallavi Joshi, Jeffrey F. Lukman, Haryadi S. Gunawi
协议
ZooKeeper (ZAB), Hadoop MapReduce/Yarn, and Cassandra — replication, leader-election and recovery paths under crashes and reboots
验证层次
Executable implementation — real production Java systems, driven through interposition/instrumentation by the model checker; covers crash-recovery and message-reordering behavior of the deployed code
工具
Custom distributed-system model checker (DMCK) with semantic-aware reduction policies layered on dynamic partial-order reduction
自动化判定
纯自动 Corrected in emphasis. No invariant and no proof is ever written, so 'auto' is right for this survey's axis. But the human input is more than 'hints': the user must supply protocol-specific semantic reduction rules (local-message independence, crash-message independence, crash-recovery symmetry, reboot synchronization) encoding real knowledge of the protocol. …
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
None. Bug finding only, and explicitly unsound: it detects safety/consistency violations reachable within a bounded number of crashes, reboots and reorderings. No proof, no unbounded guarantee, no liveness.
证明代价
No proof effort (no proof). Human cost is the per-system semantic reduction rules. Speedup over black-box DMCKs is reported in the low hundreds of times, not 2-3 orders of magnitude.
备注
Corroborating artifact: the same authors have a tool-demo paper, 'SAMC: a fast model checker for finding heisenbugs in distributed systems', ISSTA 2015, pp. 423-427 (Leesatapornwongsa & Gunawi), plus Leesatapornwongsa's 2017 UChicago thesis. RSS is credited with finding deep multi-reboot bugs in ZAB specifically. The new ZLE bug is deterministically reproducible and was reported to developers. Full text verified at https://www.usenix.org/system/files/conference/osdi14/osdi14-paper-leesatapornwongsa.pdf
352Lineage-driven Fault Injection
ACM SIGMOD 2015, pp. 331-346, DOI 10.1145/2723372.2723711
协议
14 fault-tolerant systems including single-decree Paxos (paxos-synod), the bully leader-election protocol, classic/reliable broadcast variants, 2PC, 2PC with a cooperative termination protocol, 3PC, and a model of Kafka replication
验证层次
Abstract protocol / executable specification. Protocols are written in Dedalus (a Datalog-based distributed programming language) in which implementations closely resemble pseudocode; LDFI reasons over their derivations, not over production binaries.
工具
Molly - lineage/provenance (data lineage) from a Dedalus evaluator, encoded into CNF and discharged by a SAT solver to find minimal fault schedules that break a correct outcome
自动化判定
纯自动 The human writes the protocol in Dedalus and states the outcome invariants; Molly reasons backwards from successful outcomes through the lineage, using SAT to search for fault schedules, with no invariants or proof steps supplied.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Bounded verification: for a given finite configuration (number of nodes, timesteps, crash/omission budget), Molly either produces a counterexample fault schedule or certifies that no fault-tolerance bug exists in that configuration - a genuine completeness claim, but only within the bound. …
证明代价
not reported; identified 7 critical bugs across 14 systems, often with an order of magnitude fewer executions than random fault injection
备注
Founding work for the fault-injection-guided-by-formal-lineage family, with zero prior representation in the survey. Directly informed Netflix's production failure-testing practice (LDFI was productionized there). The Kafka replication counterexample is the paper's motivating example. | Confirmed as submitted. The conceptual contribution is duality: rather than forward-searching the fault space, derive the minimal fault sets that could break every derivation of the good outcome. …
353Minimizing Faulty Executions of Distributed Systems
USENIX NSDI 2016, pp. 291-309
协议
akka-raft (a Scala/Akka Raft implementation) and Apache Spark
验证层次
Executable implementation - specifically, the counterexample traces produced when model-checking/fuzzing real implementations. DEMi is a post-processing layer on implementation-level executions.
工具
DEMi (Distributed Execution Minimizer), an AspectJ/Akka interposition layer applying delta-debugging over external events and message deliveries, with schedule exploration to find equivalent shorter executions
自动化判定
纯自动 Given a violating execution and an invariant checker, DEMi automatically shrinks the trace by systematically removing external events and re-exploring internal schedules; no human invariants or proof steps are involved.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
None proven - DEMi reduces counterexamples to violations of user-supplied safety invariants (Raft's Leader Safety, Log Matching, Election Safety, State Machine Safety).
证明代价
not reported; the paper reports 1-2 orders of magnitude reduction in counterexample length
备注
Found 7 bugs in akka-raft: 4 leader-election bugs (accepting duplicate votes within a term, inconsistent handling of stale-term votes, followers forgetting their vote on step-down permitting two leaders, incorrect quorum computation causing premature commit), 2 state-management bugs (client commands processed before leader initialization; ambiguous log indexing preventing rejection of inconsistent entries), and 1 crash-recovery bug (restart losing voting state, enabling duplicate leaders). Counterexample minimization is a capability essentially absent elsewhere in the survey. Verified: 1x-4.6x of optimal (1.6x me …
354Uncovering Bugs in Distributed Storage Systems during Testing (Not in Production!)
USENIX FAST 2016, pp. 249-262
协议
Azure Storage vNext extent replication and repair protocol (Extent Manager / Extent Nodes), Live Table Migration (MigratingTable) consistency protocol, and Azure Service Fabric's primary/secondary replication with leader election and replica catch-up
验证层次
Executable implementation. Real production C# components (e.g. the actual vNext ExtentManager) are wrapped in P# machines; the environment (Extent Nodes, network engine, failures) is modelled, so the code under test is production code, not a model.
工具
P# (an extension of C# with modelling, specification and systematic testing), with safety and liveness monitors and randomized/priority-based schedulers
自动化判定
纯自动 Developers write a test harness, environment models, declared nondeterminism sources, and safety/liveness monitors - but no invariants and no proofs; P# then systematically explores schedules until a monitor fires.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Safety (assertions and safety monitors) and liveness (liveness monitors detecting states from which a desired condition is never reached). Bounded/incomplete: coverage is by exploration, not proof.
证明代价
8 serious bugs uncovered across the three case studies; the paper reports test-harness LOC per system and reproduction rates. Not a proof-effort measure.
备注
The headline result is a liveness bug in Azure Storage vNext (extents never being repaired) that had intermittently manifested in stress testing for months without being diagnosed; P# reproduced it in a small configuration with a full system trace. The paper explicitly positions itself against TLA+, arguing formal methods check high-level models while this approach checks the executable code. Flagship Microsoft industrial report for the P# line; counterpart to the ModP OOPSLA 2018 paper. …
355Antithesis (autonomous deterministic-simulation testing platform) ⚠︎
PRACTICE-ONLY — commercial product, no peer-reviewed publication. Company founded 2018; publicly emerged 2024-02-13 with 'Is something bugging you?' (Will Wilson, antithesis.com/blog). Best independent documentation is the etcd project's 'Autonomous Testing of etcd's Robustness' by Marek Siarkowicz (Google), 2025-10-03, https://etcd.io/blog/2025/autonomus_testing_with_antithesis/ (note the URL's 'autonomus' typo).
作者
Will Wilson (Co-founder & CEO) and Dave Scherer (FoundationDB's chief architect), Antithesis
协议
etcd (Raft) — integrated into the etcd maintainers' workflow after the v3.5 data-inconsistency issues; testing covered stable releases 3.4, 3.5, 3.6 and the main development branch, on 3-node and 1-node clusters.
验证层次
end-to-end system (entire clusters run inside a deterministic hypervisor)
工具
Antithesis
自动化判定
纯自动 Determinism is provided BELOW the application by a hypervisor emulating a deterministic computer, rather than by a language runtime as in FoundationDB's Flow — so unmodified, arbitrary-language, multi-process systems can be tested. …
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing proven. Randomized, hypervisor-deterministic falsification with exact reproduction. The etcd write-up describes declarative property-based assertions ('data consistency is never violated', 'a watch event is never dropped') that the platform actively searches to violate.
证明代价
No proofs. Effort figures now exist but only from the user side (etcd): 830 wall-clock hours simulating 4.5 years of usage. The FoundationDB provenance claim about shipping only one user-reported bug before the 2015 Apple acquisition remains a company/founder claim; Wilson's own 2024 post says only '~zero bugs' and that they 'wrote our own Paxos implementation in very little time and it had no bugs.' The survey should attribute all of this as vendor/founde …
备注
The survey's central point about this entry stands and is now better evidenced — a technique with a documented, consequential effect on a production consensus implementation (etcd found a watch bug present in every stable release, and had a flaw in its own checker exposed) with zero peer-reviewed evaluation. Confidence stays medium because everything remains vendor- or user-blog-sourced. Note also that TigerBeetle's own documentation explicitly credits both FoundationDB and Antithesis as its inspiration for deterministic simulation testing, so all three entries form one traceable lineage.
356Compositional Programming and Testing of Dynamic Distributed Systems
PACMPL 2(OOPSLA), Article 159, pp. 159:1-159:30, 2018 (OOPSLA 2018), DOI 10.1145/3276529
协议
Multi-Paxos state-machine replication, Chain Replication SMR, and Two-Phase Commit, composed into a replicated hash-table service and a transaction-commit service
验证层次
Refinement between layers plus executable implementation. ModP modules are compiled to C and deployed; the theory is compositional trace refinement (assume-guarantee) between an implementation module and its abstraction, and both refinement and safety are discharged by systematic testing rather than proof.
工具
ModP (a module system on top of the P/P# actor language), with a systematic-testing back end (systematic and randomized schedule exploration)
自动化判定
纯自动 The programmer supplies the protocol implementation, temporal-property monitors, and hand-written abstraction modules, but no inductive invariants and no proof steps - the tool systematically explores schedules to check safety and to check that each implementation module refines its abstraction.
保证强度
有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立
证明的性质
Safety (component-level temporal properties via monitors) and trace-refinement between implementation and abstraction, both established by bounded systematic testing rather than proof. No liveness, no unbounded guarantee.
证明代价
3601 source lines of ModP total: Multi-Paxos SMR 1617 impl / 101 specs / 121 abstractions / 92 test-driver / 90 test-decls; Chain-Replication SMR 1267 impl; Two-Phase Commit 441 impl; data structures 276.
备注
Compositional testing uncovered 20 critical bugs in the software stack and amplified coverage by orders of magnitude versus monolithic testing. The ModP Multi-Paxos-backed hash table reached 72%-80% of the peak throughput of the (highly optimized Go) open-source EPaxos codebase on an Azure cluster, i.e. rigorous testing did not cost an order of magnitude in performance. This is the P/P#/ModP industrial lineage; ModP later informed P's use at AWS.

Journal of Logical and Algebraic Methods in Programming (JLAMP), vol. 104, pp. 254-273
作者
Rui Wang, Lars Michael Kristensen, Hein Meling, Volker Stolz
协议
Single-decree (classic) Paxos: proposer/acceptor/learner phases

Two layers bridged: (i) an abstract CPN model of single-decree Paxos, explored to obtain a state space; (ii) an executable Go implementation built on the Gorums RPC framework, exercised by conformance test cases automatically derived from the CPN state space. Proc. VLDB Endowment 14(3):268-280, 2020 (presented at VLDB 2021); also CoRR abs/2003.10554

自动化判定
纯自动 Fully black-box and push-button: the human chooses the workload and claimed isolation level; Elle generates histories, injects faults, builds the dependency graph and reports anomalies with explanatory counterexamples. No model, no invariants, no proof.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Detects (does not prove absence of) violations of isolation levels in the Adya formalism - e.g. G0/G1a/G1b/G1c, lost update, aborted/intermediate reads, and serializability/strict-serializability violations - each accompanied by a concrete counterexample.
证明代价
not reported; the paper includes a case study of four real databases
备注
The formal underpinning of Jepsen, which is empirically the most consequential correctness-checking effort ever applied to consensus-backed systems. Represents the black-box observational-checking tradition, absent from the survey's otherwise specification-level consistency coverage (Cosmos DB, CCF, Chapar). The key technical move is confirmed: Adya's formalism needs a version order, which black-box observation does not give you, so Elle chooses datatypes (append-only lists, counters) …

协议

备注
Discovered 22 zero-day bugs (18 developer-confirmed), including 10 new vulnerabilities with 6 CVEs assigned, in Braft, Dqlite and Redis. Explores 54.27% more distinct states than Jepsen in 24h with a 2.24x speedup, and finds bugs 1.87x faster. A direct, 20-minutes-per-system bridge from specification-level formal work to implementation-level fuzzing. The honest negative result is also confirmed: Dqlite-356 and Dqlite-314 were missed by Mallory and found by Jepsen.

executable implementation (production codebases, driven through an instrumented network/process-fault injector)

ByzzFuzz — randomized systematic testing with structure-aware 'small-scope' message mutations (small changes in value or in time) plus network partition faults

纯自动 Human supplies the implementation and the correctness oracle (agreement/termination monitors); the tool randomly explores the fault and mutation space. No invariant, no inductive reasoning, no soundness/completeness guarantee.

仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准

Bug finding only. N/A (randomized testing, not proof) — no soundness or completeness guarantee

Bibliographic record fully verified (dblp + Crossref). The findings summary matches the paper's published claims but I could not re-read the full text this session (ACM DL returns 403 to unauthenticated fetches and the paper is not on arXiv), so treat the per-bug breakdown as high- but not text-verified confidence. The survey gap the record identifies — ByzzFuzz was not applied to Zyzzyva, SBFT or Zelma — is consistent with the three-system benchmark set.

19 distributed/concurrent protocols used as safety-verification benchmarks (all EPR benchmarks from Feldman et al. except purely universal ones). 纯自动 Confirmed. Symbolic abstraction computes the least fixpoint of the best abstract transformer with no user-supplied invariant. The user provides the protocol, the safety property, and a bounded language (quantifier prefix plus k-pDNF parameters, following Koenig et al.). …

有界检验 结论只对所检查的有限实例成立

The LSet data structure is what makes the enormous formula sets (~100,000 formulas for the cache example) tractable — with a naive data structure the cache example gets stuck at ~20,000 formulas and misses the 3 h limit.

381Runtime Protocol Refinement Checking for Distributed Protocol Implementations
NSDI 2025 (22nd USENIX Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation), pp. 1305-1326
作者
Ding Ding, Zhanghan Wang, Jinyang Li, Aurojit Panda (all NYU)
协议
Three open-source 'distributed protocol implementations' (DPIs): Etcd and Redis Raft (both implement the Raft consensus protocol) and ZooKeeper (implements the Zab atomic broadcast protocol). Fail-stop, asynchronous/partially-synchronous model; explicitly NOT Byzantine.
验证层次
Deployed implementation, at runtime. An Ellsberg instance is co-located with each DPI process, treats the DPI as a blackbox with no access to internal state, observes only the trace of messages sent/received, and simulates a correct protocol implementation to detect divergence. Not a proof: per-execution bug detection.
工具
Ellsberg — custom runtime protocol refinement checking (RPRC) system. Input is a TLA+ protocol specification supplied by the protocol designer, from which the administrator/programmer derives an 'Ellsberg specification'. …
自动化判定
纯自动 No invariants and no proofs are written. The human effort is authoring/deriving the Ellsberg specification from the protocol's TLA+ spec and deploying co-located instances; detection thereafter is fully automatic, local to each process, and requires no coordination or extra communication between instances.
保证强度
仅找 bug 不给出任何正确性保证,只找 bug 或只是规约/工具/基准
证明的性质
Nothing is proven. Runtime DETECTION of protocol-implementation bugs that manifest as divergence in the content or order of messages sent/received, given the fail-stop assumption. The paper is explicit that this is complementary to, not a replacement for, static verification (IronFleet, Verus, Goose are cited as the static alternatives) …
证明代价
No proof effort (not a proof system). Reported runtime overhead: worst case 11% impact on 99th-percentile response latency, no impact on throughput, modest processing and memory requirements. Detected/reproduced previously reported protocol bugs in Etcd (stale values on a linearizable read), ZooKeeper (lost updates during leader elections), and Redis Raft.
备注
Not on arXiv. One nuance worth carrying into the survey: the paper's own related-work section distinguishes RPRC from 'trace validation' (checking test-generated traces against a TLA+ spec) — Ellsberg's contribution is that it works incrementally, in deployment, without the full future trace.

4.6 概率/随机化共识的定量验证

Probabilistic model checking — 4 项

共识里有一整类随机化算法(Ben-Or、Aspnes–Herlihy、Rabin,以及现代的 common-coin BFT 与 Nakamoto 共识),它们的正确性是概率性的——"以概率 1 终止"而不是"一定终止"。这需要概率模型检验(PRISM、UPPAAL-SMC、Storm)或概率 I/O 自动机,而不是普通的状态穷举。

这一节条目少,但不代表工作少:随机化共识的定量验证有相当一部分被归入了阈值自动机那条线(见 §4.2 参数化验证与阈值自动机),因为 Konnov 等人把概率终止性建模成了概率阈值自动机的性质。这是一个方法上高度分散、尚未整合的方向。

The automated counterpart to the Stoelinga-Vaandrager manual I/O-automata proof of the identical protocol, which makes the pair an ideal manual-versus-automatic contrast on randomised agreement. Closely related: Daws, Kwiatkowska & Norman, 'Automatic Verification of the IEEE 1394 Root Contention Protocol with KRONOS and PRISM' (ENTCS 66(2):104-119, 2002; journal version STTT 5(2-3):221-236, 2004). This is the timed-probabilistic branch of randomised-consensus verification, distinct from both the threshold-automata line and the theorem-proving line.

Quantitative security properties of the Backbone abstraction — common prefix and chain-quality-style properties, and adversarial advantage under selfish mining — as probability estimates for concrete parameterisations rather than asymptotic theorems. …

not reported; reported as simulation counts/confidence intervals

The model-checking counterpart to the otherwise theorem-proving-only Nakamoto/PoW literature (Toychain CPP 2018, Kaizen FMCAD 2019, Coq/Isabelle Bitcoin backbone formalisations). 351-358, DOI 10.1109/BLOCKCHAIN50366.2020.00051) and arXiv:2007.08644 (submitted 16 July 2020).

4.7 LLM 与学习驱动的自动化(2023–2026)

LLM- and learning-driven automation — 15 项

2023 年之后出现的新方向,目前几乎全部是 2025–2026 年的工作,多数尚未经过同行评议,引用时需注意。可以分成四类:

  1. 自动补证明:Laurel(Dafny 引理合成)、AutoVerus / ExVerus / VeruSAGE(Verus 证明生成与反例修复)、IsabeLLM(Isabelle + Sledgehammer 驱动共识证明)。
  2. 辅助不变式推断:PSyn(LLM 当谓词提议器,再交给传统推断引擎)、IC3Syn(神经符号,LLM 提候选 + IC3 做符号验证)。这是目前最有说服力的一类——LLM 负责猜,符号引擎负责验,错了不会漏。
  3. TLA+ 方向:Retrieval-Augmented TLAPS Proof Generation、Towards Language Model Guided TLA+ Proof Automation、TLA-Prover(20B 模型微调)、TLA+-Bench(执行为准的基准)、Specula(LLM agent 生成规约驱动模型检验)。
  4. 端到端 agent:Agora(生产级共识协议的自主 bug 检测)、Inductive-Deductive Synthesis。

判断建议:第 2 类(LLM 提议 + 符号验证)在方法论上是可靠的,因为最终结论仍由求解器把关;第 1、3 类的价值取决于生成的证明是否真的通过了检查器;第 4 类目前仍以基准和 demo 为主。

Important framing caveat for the survey: this produces no proof of any kind, so it belongs in a different column from IC3Syn or IronFleet despite sharing the 'auto' label -- bounded bug finding versus unbounded safety. Successor in spirit to SysMoBench from the same Illinois/UBC group; the GitHub-maintenance and industrial-adoption claims in the submitted notes were not independently checked.

5. 交叉索引

5.1 按会议

按会议倒查,方便定位「某个顶会上到底有哪些共识验证工作」。

读索引时务必同时看两个标签。「纯自动」只说明人没有写归纳不变式,不说明结论有多强;紧跟其后的「无界证明 / 有界检验 / 仅找 bug」才是保证强度。例如 Raft 组里挂着「纯自动」的条目绝大多数是有界模型检验或测试工具,不是证明。

6. 分析

6.1 三类方法的真实代价

把各条目里核对过的原始数字放在一起,三类方法的代价差异非常清楚:

工作类别层次证明代价(原文数字)
Verdi Raft(CPP 2016)纯手写(Coq)L4 可执行530 行实现 / 50,000 行证明 ≈ 94:1,90 条不变式
Velisarios PBFT(ESOP 2018)纯手写(Coq)L4 可执行20,000 行规约 + 22,000 行证明,约 1 人年
Grove(SOSP 2023)纯手写(Coq/Iris)L5 端到端2,435 行 Go / 28,077 行 Coq ≈ 12:1
IronFleet(SOSP 2015)半自动(Dafny)L5 端到端5,114 行实现 / 39,253 行证明 ≈ 7.7:1,验证 395 分钟
Anvil(OSDI 2024)半自动(Verus)L4 可执行 + 活性proof:code 4.5–7.4,每个控制器 ≈2.5 人月
Sift(ATC 2022)半自动(Ivy+精化)L3/L4Raft 1 人月(原 Ivy 证明为 3 人月);MultiPaxos ≈3 人周
Paxos made EPR(OOPSLA 2017)半自动(Ivy)L1 抽象协议六个变体,不变式检查各 1.0–4.7 秒;人写不变式
DistAI(OSDI 2021)纯自动L1 抽象协议0.8–58.8 秒,人不写不变式
DuoAI(OSDI 2022)纯自动L1 抽象协议1.3 秒 – 7.5 小时(Fast Paxos 26,979 秒)
SWISS(NSDI 2021)纯自动L1 抽象协议two-phase commit 6 秒;Flexible Paxos 18,232 秒
IC3PO(NFM 2021)纯自动L1 抽象协议1 秒 – 1,300 秒;29 个基准解出 29 个(I4 为 13)

读法:纵向不可直接比较。DistAI 的 58 秒和 IronFleet 的 3.7 人年不在同一个层次上——前者证的是 L1 抽象协议的安全性,后者证的是 L5 端到端系统的安全性加活性。真正可比的是同层次内的对比:Sift 的 1 人月 vs 原 Ivy 证明的 3 人月(同为 Raft,同为精化路线),这才是有意义的"自动化收益"。

6.2 覆盖断层与已确认的空白

把全部 415 条按"层次 × 自动化程度"铺开,会看到一个非常清晰的对角线空洞:

  • 左上角(L1 抽象协议 × 纯自动)非常拥挤。I4、DistAI、DuoAI、SWISS、IC3PO、fol-ic3、P-FOL-IC3、endive、Primal-Dual Houdini 等十几个系统在高度重合的基准集上互相刷分。
  • 右下角(L5 端到端 × 纯自动)是空的。没有任何工作能自动验证一个可运行的共识实现。
  • 能到 L4/L5 的工作全部是纯手写或半自动,且全部需要人年到人月级投入。

在这个对角线之上,有五个覆盖断层:

  1. 生产级特性几乎无人验证。 日志压缩与快照、批处理与流水线、状态传输、读租约、崩溃后从持久化存储恢复——除 IronRSL 及其后续外,几乎所有 Paxos/Raft 验证工作都显式地把这些排除在外(Verdi-Raft 的排除清单尤其长,见 §6.4 第 6 条)。这是本领域最中心的空白。
  2. 已验证 BFT 且带系统级评测的工作近乎没有。 只有 AutoMan 的 ByzRSL 一项报了吞吐量;Velisarios 与 Asphalion 虽抽取出 OCaml,但从未作为系统被评测过。
  3. 硬件/网络卸载共识没有任何验证工作。 NetPaxos、NOPaxos(OSDI 2016)、Eris(SOSP 2017)、Consensus in a Box、P4xos(ToN 2020)、Hydra(NSDI 2023)、RDMA/eBPF/SmartNIC 共识——这些系统论文本身都不含形式化验证,也没有第三方验证过它们。这是一个干净的开放问题,不是检索遗漏。
  4. 共享日志与存储-共识协同设计(CORFU、Delos、Boki、Scalog、LogDrive)几乎没有形式化产出,尽管 Delos 就是生产环境里的虚拟化共识基础设施。
  5. 故障模型单一。 几乎所有条目假设崩溃/遗漏/Byzantine 故障加统一网络。部分连通(partial connectivity)与灰色故障——真实生产事故的主要来源——在整个文献里近乎不存在(Omni-Paxos 是少数例外)。

最后一个跨越三类方法的模式,值得单独点出:协议里被设计成"动态"的那部分(重配置、视图变更、恢复),系统性地是被排除在形式化规约之外的那部分,也系统性地是最后被发现有错的那部分。 Raft 的 TLA+ 规约只覆盖静态协议;EPaxos 的 TLA+ 规约省略了 recovery;CCF 的规约最初把重配置钩子"以低保真度 mock 掉"。CCF 的数据把这件事量化了:它找到的六个 bug 里,两个重配置 bug 的反例长到"已经不可能在白板上推完",而那个安全性 bug(选举 quorum 按活跃配置的并集而不是逐个配置计票)正是在给原本正确的代码加上重配置时引入的。

6.3 趋势

  1. 2015 是拐点。 IronFleet(SOSP)与 Verdi(PLDI)在同一年出现,把共识验证从形式化方法社区推进了系统社区。此后 2015–2024 的产出是之前三十年的数倍。
  2. 自动化的收益集中在 L1,而不是端到端。 不变式推断这七年的进步是真实的(IC3PO 在 29 个基准上全解,I4 只解 13),但它没有改变"要验证一个能跑的共识实现仍需人月到人年"这个事实。
  3. 降低半自动路线的代价,比追求全自动更有现实回报。 Sift 把 Raft 从 3 人月压到 1 人月、Kondo 用不变式分类法消除样板、AutoMan 自动生成实现层代码与精化证明——这条线的每一步都直接作用在 L3–L5。
  4. 工业界从"证明"转向"规约 + 模型检验 + 轨迹校验"。 AWS 2015→2021→2025 的三篇论文清楚地记录了这个转向:从 TLA+ 建模,到轻量形式化方法,到 TLA+/P/确定性仿真的组合拳。学术界的定理证明工作在生产环境里几乎没有直接采用者。
  5. BFT / 区块链把资金和注意力带进了这个领域,并催生了 Velisarios、Asphalion、LiDO、AdoB、Bythos 一类新框架,以及大量 HotStuff/Tendermint/Algorand/Casper 的验证。但这批工作绝大多数停在协议层。
  6. LLM 在 2025–2026 集中涌入,目前最可信的形态是"LLM 提议 + 符号引擎验证"(PSyn、IC3Syn),因为它保留了求解器作为最终裁判。

6.4 已确认的「不存在」

以下是本调研从多个角度反复检索后确认的"不存在"。确认的缺席和确认的存在一样是结果,列在这里以免后来者重复检索。

协议族层面

  1. EPaxos 至今没有任何机械化验证。 Coq/Rocq、Isabelle、Lean、Ivy、Dafny、F*、TLAPS 里都没有。SOSP 2013 至今十二年,最强的产物是:(a) 一个不完整的 TLA+ 模型加一份笔算技术报告(CMU-PDL-13-111);(b) Sutra 用 TLC 找到的反例(IPL 2020),推翻了原协议;(c) EPaxos\*(OPODIS 2025)修正了 recovery 算法,而修正后的证明仍然是手写的。被引用最多的 leaderless 共识协议,从来没有过机器检查的安全性证明。
  2. 整个后 EPaxos 的 leaderless 家族都未机械化:Atlas(EuroSys 2020)、Tempo(EuroSys 2021)、Caesar(DSN 2017)、Matchmaker / Bipartisan / Compartmentalized Paxos 全部只有手写证明。唯一的例外是 Rabia(SOSP 2021,Ivy + Coq)——而 Rabia 之所以能做到,是因为它用随机化二元共识替换掉了依赖图。这本身就是结论:依赖图式的定序机制正是抗拒机械化的那个东西。
  3. Viewstamped Replication 没有专门的机械化验证。 视图变更这个概念的发源地,其 view change 从未在同行评议工作中被形式化验证过。生产级 VSR 实现(如 TigerBeetle)仓库里有 TLA+ 模型,但没有发表的机械验证。
  4. 可重配置原子存储全线未机械化:RAMBO、RAMBO II、DynaStore、SmartMerge 都只有笔算的 I/O 自动机证明。
  5. Delos / 虚拟共识未被验证。 Delos(OSDI 2020)把重配置分解进一个可复用的 VirtualLog 层,是已发表的重配置设计里架构上最适合验证的一个,却没有 TLA+ 规约、没有模型检验、没有证明。最接近的已验证亲戚是 WormSpace(Coq),但它早于且不覆盖 VirtualLog/Loglet 的划分。这是一个现成的、完全开放的机会。
  6. Raft 的重配置是"没规约的地方就是有 bug 的地方"的典型案例。 Raft 发布时的 TLA+ 规约只覆盖静态协议;Verdi-Raft 的 Coq 验证明确排除了重配置、日志压缩、已验证的序列化/反序列化、状态传输、日志截断、动态视图变更超时、回复缓存和批处理;IronFleet 同样排除重配置。而 Ongaro 学位论文里的单服务器成员变更算法,在 2015 年 5 月被 Amos 与 Zhang 靠纯人工推理发现不安全——没有工具抓到它,因为没有工具被指向它。据本调研所知,joint consensus 至今没有属于自己的机器检查安全性证明(MongoRaftReconfig 验证的是另一个 logless 协议;CCF 模型检验了一个类 joint-consensus 的协议但没有归纳证明)。
  7. BFT 的跨配置证明不存在。 HotStuff 的 Ivy 安全性证明(FORTE 2021)只覆盖单个配置/epoch,作者明说跨配置变更是未来工作。经典 PBFT/HotStuff 系的成员变更没有机械化验证;唯一的例外在 DAG/区块链一侧(带动态权益的 DAG-BFT 的 ACL2 工作,2025)。

方法族层面

  1. invisible-invariants 学派从未验证过共识(见 §4.2)。
  2. 实现层模型检验这条线里没有 BFT、没有活性、也没有任何保证(见 §4.5)。
  3. 确定性仿真几乎没有同行评议评测。 整个确定性仿真领域只有两篇同行评议产物:FoundationDB(SIGMOD 2021)和 Shadow/Phantom(ATC 2022,而后者是 Tor 网络仿真器,不是共识检查器)。Antithesis、TigerBeetle VOPR、madsim、各家自研仿真器全部是实践产物,无论文、无公开 bug 计数、无对照基线。被反复引用的"FoundationDB 在 2015 年被 Apple 收购前只收到过一个用户报告的 bug"是创始人的说法,从未被独立测量。没有任何一项公开研究在同一个共识实现上对照比较过确定性仿真、dmck(SAMC/FlyMC)与模糊测试(Mallory)。
  4. Jepsen 的共识发现基本在同行评议文献之外。 十年、二十多个数据库与协调服务(etcd、ZooKeeper、MongoDB、RethinkDB、Consul、TiDB、CockroachDB、YugabyteDB、Cassandra LWT、TigerBeetle)的结果只以 jepsen.io 技术报告和会议演讲的形式存在。唯一同行评议的核心是 Elle(PVLDB 2020),而它讲的是事务隔离性推断,不是共识/线性一致性的那些发现。Jepsen 的线性一致性检查器 Knossos 没有自己的论文。
  5. 没有任何系统性研究说明哪类共识 bug 该用哪种方法找。 bug 分类全部是逐篇、临时的。举例来说:DEMi 在 akka-raft 上找到的那些 bug(quorum 用众数而非中位数计算、状态转移时丢掉 votedFor、日志 0-索引与 1-索引的歧义),究竟能不能被 TLA+ 规约、被 Verdi/IronFleet 式的证明、被 Jepsen、或被确定性仿真抓到?没有人做过这个对照矩阵——而这本身就是一个现成的研究课题。

厂商层面

  1. Meta 零形式化产出;Google 没有公开的 Chubby/Spanner 验证;没有任何生产共识实现有端到端精化证明(三条均见 §4.4)。
  2. 检索后未找到任何已发表形式化验证的还有:字节跳动、YugabyteDB、Redis/RedisRaft(唯一严肃的公开分析是 Jepsen 对 redis-raft 的报告,发现了严重的安全性违规)、IBM Hyperledger Fabric 的 SmartBFT 排序服务(生产级金融基础设施共识,却没有 TLA+/Coq/Ivy 验证)、Amazon Aurora 的 quorum/日志协议。

如果要用一句话概括这 415 项工作:共识协议家族中的一小部分,其抽象层安全性已经可以自动证明了;共识系统的正确性还远远不能。

这句话里的每个限定词都是必要的,请不要压缩它:

  • "一小部分"——自动不变式推断解决的是 Paxos 家族在 EPR/Ivy 编码下的单值与多值变体。vertical Paxos 至今无人解出;带日志的完整 Raft 从未被自动证明过;基准集本身只有约 27–30 个协议且各工具间高度重合。
  • "抽象层安全性"——全部是 L1。没有活性、没有精化、没有可执行代码、没有崩溃恢复、没有重配置、没有日志压缩。
  • "可以"而非"已经"——成功率是概率性的:P-FOL-IC3 在 stoppable-paxos 上 5 次里成功 2 次,Primal-Dual Houdini 在 paxos-h 上 10 次里成功 2 次;耗时可达 7.5 小时。
  • "自动证明"而非"自动验证"——"纯自动"这一档里数量最多的其实是有界模型检验与测试,它们找 bug 极其有效,但不产生任何对无界执行成立的结论。

后半句则完全没有限定词的余地:所有到达可运行实现的工作,无一例外仍需人月到人年级的人工投入,而且没有一项是自动方法做到的。

附录 A:被剔除的条目

第二轮核验剔除了以下条目。两项都真实存在且引用信息已核准,剔除原因纯粹是超出"分布式/共识协议验证"的范围,在此列出以免后来者重复检索:

  • Lemur: Integrating Large Language Models in Automated Program Verification(ICLR 2024,Haoze Wu、Clark Barrett、Nina Narodytska,arXiv:2310.04870)——验证的是顺序程序,不是分布式协议。
  • AlphaVerus: Bootstrapping Formally Verified Code Generation through Self-Improving Translation and Treefinement(ICML 2025,PMLR vol. 267;注意常被误引为 2024 年 arXiv 预印本)——面向通用可验证代码生成,不针对共识协议。

此外 1 条无法在线独立核实(Taurus 数据库共识验证,FM 2021 Industry Day),已在正文中标注 low 可信度。
